data.title: Seguro quer medidas preventivas para enfrentar futuras tempestades
data.description: O presidente da República garante que vai avaliar as medidas preventivas propostas no relatório sobre a tempestade Kristin. António José Seguro admite que Estado não estava preparado para tanta devastação.
data.translatedTitle: Insurance wants preventive measures to face future storms
data.translatedDescription: The President of the Republic guarantees that he will evaluate the preventive measures proposed in the report on Storm Kristin. António José Seguro admits that the State was not prepared for so much devastation.

data.title: Judiciária abre processos por fugas de informação internas
data.description: A Polícia Judiciária abriu dois processos disciplinares por alegadas fugas de informação e eventuais violações de deveres funcionais a trabalhadores da PJ. Isto numa altura em que permanecem dúvidas sobre se a empresa Construbarcelos fez ou não obras em casa do Diretor Financeiro da PJ.
data.translatedTitle: Judiciary opens cases for internal information leaks
data.translatedDescription: The Judiciary Police opened two disciplinary proceedings for alleged leaks of information and possible violations of functional duties involving PJ workers. This at a time when doubts remain about whether or not the company Construbarcelos carried out work on the house of the PJ's Financial Director.

data.title: Casos de jovens que matam os pais são muito raros em Portugal
data.description: Em outubro de 2025 um jovem de 14 anos matou também a mãe em Vagos, no distrito de Aveiro.
data.translatedTitle: Cases of young people killing their parents are very rare in Portugal
data.translatedDescription: In October 2025, a 14-year-old boy also killed his mother in Vagos, in the district of Aveiro.

data.title: Líder da Federação de Ciclismo diz que a Volta “terá de continuar” após morte de Tarling
data.description: O presidente da Federação Portuguesa de Ciclismo (FPC), Cândido Barbosa, afirmou hoje que a 87.ª Volta a Portugal em bicicleta vai “ter de continuar”, após o corredor britânico Finlay Tarling, de 19 anos, morrer num acidente na oitava etapa.
data.translatedTitle: Leader of the Cycling Federation says the Tour “will have to continue” after Tarling’s death
data.translatedDescription: The president of the Portuguese Cycling Federation (FPC), Cândido Barbosa, said today that the 87th Tour of Portugal on bicycles will “have to continue”, after 19-year-old British racer Finlay Tarling died in an accident in the eighth stage.

data.title: Governo aprova aumento de capital de 20 milhões de euros na RTP
data.description: Em declarações durante a Festa do Pontal, no Algarve, o ministro da tutela afastou, por agora, um cenário de privatização da rádio e televisão pública.
data.translatedTitle: Government approves capital increase of 20 million euros in RTP
data.translatedDescription: In statements during the Festa do Pontal, in the Algarve, the responsible minister ruled out, for now, a scenario of privatization of public radio and television.

data.title: Pontegadea vende participação de 13,7% na REN à Parpública
data.description: A Pontegadea Inversiones celebrou um contrato com a Parpública para a venda de 91.723.676 ações da REN, representativas de 13,7% do capital da empresa, foi hoje comunicado ao mercado.
data.translatedTitle: Pontegadea sells 13.7% stake in REN to Parpública
data.translatedDescription: Pontegadea Inversiones signed a contract with Parpública for the sale of 91,723,676 REN shares, representing 13.7% of the company's capital, the market was announced today.

data.title: Suspeito de tráfico `apanhado` na A6 com 1.532 quilos de cocaína avaliada em 70 milhões de euros
data.description: Um homem de 31 anos ficou hoje em prisão preventiva, após ter sido detido pela Polícia Judiciária quando conduzia uma viatura na autoestrada 6 com mais de 1.500 quilos de cocaína, na zona de Estremoz, revelou o Ministério Público.
data.translatedTitle: Trafficking suspect 'caught' on the A6 with 1,532 kilos of cocaine valued at 70 million euros
data.translatedDescription: A 31-year-old man was in preventive detention today, after being detained by the Judiciary Police while driving a vehicle on Highway 6 with more than 1,500 kilos of cocaine, in the Estremoz area, revealed the Public Ministry.

data.title: Concursos do Programa de Apoio Sustentado abrem em 10 dias e dispõem de 72,84 milhões de euros
data.description: A Direção-Geral das Artes (DGArtes) publicou hoje "o teor dos avisos" dos seis concursos do Programa de Apoio Sustentado, nas modalidades bienais e quadrienais, para o período 2027-2030, que devem abrir daqui a "dez dias consecutivos".

data.title: NSN Development Team de consternada com morte de Finlay Tarling
data.description: A NSN Development Team mostrou-se hoje consternada com a morte do ciclista britânico Finlay Tarling, de 19 anos, que representava a equipa suíça na Volta a Portugal e desapareceu na oitava e antepenúltima etapa.
data.translatedTitle: NSN Development Team appalled by death of Finlay Tarling
data.translatedDescription: The NSN Development Team was saddened today by the death of British cyclist Finlay Tarling, aged 19, who represented the Swiss team in the Volta a Portugal and disappeared in the eighth and third-to-last stage.

data.translatedDescription: The Portuguese Ricardo Melo Gouveia advanced two positions today, to the group of 15th placed in the Danish Golf Championship taking place in Kerteminde, Denmark, while Daniel Rodrigues dropped to 99th, missing the cut.

data.title: Libya’s central bank chief resigns
data.description:
TRIPOLI: The governor of Libya’s central bank, Naji Issa, has resigned without giving a reason, several reports said on Monday.
	Private TV channel Al-Ahrar said Issa had confirmed his resignation.
	Issa and vice-governor Miree Al-Barasee were appointed by Libya’s parliament, which is based in the east of the divided country, in September 2024.
	His appointment was part of a deal backed by the United Nations that ended a standoff over Libya’s oil production and a deep financial crisis.

data.title: Trump insists Netanyahu relationship ‘very good’ despite Gaza rift
data.description:
WASHINGTON, United States: President Donald Trump insisted on Monday that his relationship with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is “very good” despite the Israeli leader’s rejection of a US-led Gaza plan.
	“The relationship is very good,” Trump said in response to a shouted question from a journalist at the end of an Oval Office event.
	After more than a week of gradually escalating criticism, Netanyahu explicitly stated on Sunday that he opposed the Gaza plan, which called for Israel to begin pulling back forces in tandem with disarmament by Hamas.

data.title: Can Al-Burhan’s Sudanese national dialogue turn military gains into a political settlement?
data.description:
LONDON: More than three years after Sudan descended into civil war, army chief Gen. Abdel Fattah Al-Burhan is pushing for a broad national dialogue aimed at rebuilding the country’s political institutions and laying the foundations for a civilian transition.

	Talks could begin as early as August, with preparatory consultations already involving political groups, technocrats, Sufi leaders, traditional authorities, academics, professionals, civil society representatives and independent figures.

	The meeting focused on ways to strengthen cooperation between Syria and UNHCR, as well as supporting efforts related to the voluntary, safe, dignified and sustainable return of refugees and early recovery and livelihood projects.

data.title: Linga : l’insalubrité s’aggrave avec la saison des pluies
data.description: Dans certains quartiers du village Linga, l’insalubrité chronique s’aggrave avec la saison des pluies, une situation qui préoccupe les notables, qui déplorent les conditions de vie difficiles des habitants. L’article Linga : l’insalubrité s’aggrave avec la saison des pluies est apparu en premier sur Radio Ndeke Luka .
data.translatedTitle: Linga: unsanitary conditions worsen with the rainy season
data.translatedDescription: In certain neighborhoods of the Linga village, chronic unsanitary conditions worsen with the rainy season, a situation that worries the notables, who deplore the difficult living conditions of the inhabitants. The article Linga: unsanitary conditions worsen with the rainy season appeared first on Radio Ndeke Luka.

data.title: Préparatifs timides de la rentrée scolaire à Goma
data.description: À deux semaines de la rentrée scolaire 2026-2027, les préparatifs restent timides à Goma, au Nord-Kivu. Si les marchés et les papeteries proposent déjà cartables, cahiers et uniformes, de nombreux parents tardent encore à faire leurs achats. La faiblesse du pouvoir d’achat, dans un contexte économique difficile, est à la base de cette timidité.
data.translatedTitle: Shy preparations for the start of the school year in Goma
data.translatedDescription: Two weeks before the start of the 2026-2027 school year, preparations remain timid in Goma, North Kivu. Although markets and stationery stores already offer school bags, notebooks and uniforms, many parents are still delaying making their purchases. Weak purchasing power, in a difficult economic context, is the basis of this timidity.

data.title: La loi sur le référendum renvoyée au Parlement pour plus de « clarté et de sécurité juridique » (Jacques Djoli)
data.description: La proposition de loi fixant les conditions d’organisation du référendum fera l’objet d’une nouvelle délibération au Parlement dès la prochaine session ordinaire de septembre. Cette décision intervient à la demande du Président de la République, alors même que le texte avait déjà été adopté en termes identiques par l’Assemblée nationale et le Sénat, puis déclaré conforme à la Constitution par la Cour constitutionnelle.
data.translatedTitle: The law on the referendum sent back to Parliament for more “clarity and legal certainty” (Jacques Djoli)
data.translatedDescription: The bill establishing the conditions for organizing the referendum will be the subject of a new deliberation in Parliament from the next ordinary session in September. This decision comes at the request of the President of the Republic, even though the text had already been adopted in identical terms by the National Assembly and the Senate, then declared compliant with the Constitution by the Constitutional Court.

data.title: Quelle est l’importance de la médecine scolaire ?
data.description: Chaque établissement scolaire (école maternelle, école primaire, collège et lycée) doit posséder dans ses locaux un service de médecine scolaire assuré par des professionnels de santé, selon les experts. Sur le terrain la réalité est tout autre.
data.translatedTitle: What is the importance of school medicine?
data.translatedDescription: Each educational establishment (nursery school, primary school, middle school and high school) must have on its premises a school medical service provided by health professionals, according to experts. On the ground the reality is quite different.

data.title: Insultes et diffamation sur les réseaux sociaux :  Que dit la loi ?
data.translatedTitle: Insults and defamation on social networks: What does the law say?

data.title: 4 morts et des blessés dans des affrontements entre les FARDC et l’AFC/M23 à Kusisa, au Sud-Kivu
data.description: De violents affrontements opposent ce vendredi 14 août les Forces armées de la RDC (FARDC), appuyées par les combattants Wazalendo, aux rebelles de l’AFC/M23 à Kusisa, dans le groupement de Ziralo, territoire de Kalehe, au Sud-Kivu. Selon des sources concordantes, les combats, qui se sont intensifiés depuis trois jours sur l’axe Igali, ont fait au moins quatre morts dont une mère et ses deux enfants. Quatre militaires congolais auraient également été blessés.
data.translatedTitle: 4 dead and injured in clashes between the FARDC and the AFC/M23 in Kusisa, South Kivu
data.translatedDescription: Violent clashes this Friday, August 14, pitted the Armed Forces of the DRC (FARDC), supported by Wazalendo fighters, against the AFC/M23 rebels in Kusisa, in the Ziralo grouping, Kalehe territory, in South Kivu. According to consistent sources, the fighting, which has intensified for three days on the Igali axis, has left at least four dead, including a mother and her two children. Four Congolese soldiers were also injured.

data.title: Jujitsu : Christophe Mputu sollicite un appui pour préparer les athlètes au Championnat d’Afrique d’Alger
data.description: La République démocratique du Congo prendra part au Championnat d’Afrique de jujitsu, prévu du 15 au 20 septembre 2026 à Alger, en Algérie. À l’approche de cette compétition continentale, l’Association congolaise de jujitsu appelle les autorités du pays à soutenir la préparation des athlètes, notamment à travers le financement d’un stage à l’étranger.
data.translatedTitle: Jujitsu: Christophe Mputu seeks support to prepare athletes for the African Championship in Algiers
data.translatedDescription: The Democratic Republic of Congo will take part in the African Jujitsu Championship, scheduled for September 15-20, 2026 in Algiers, Algeria. As this continental competition approaches, the Congolese Jujitsu Association calls on the country's authorities to support the preparation of athletes, in particular through the financing of an internship abroad.

data.title: Le gouvernement provincial du Kasaï-Central interpellé sur le bilan officiel du naufrage sur la rivière Lulua
data.description: Plus d’une semaine après le naufrage d’une pirogue sur la rivière Lulua, dans le territoire de Demba, le gouvernement provincial du Kasaï-Central est interpellé sur l’absence d’assistance officielle aux familles des victimes et sur le bilan de l’accident.
data.translatedTitle: The provincial government of Kasaï-Central questioned on the official report of the shipwreck on the Lulua River
data.translatedDescription: More than a week after the sinking of a canoe on the Lulua River, in the Demba territory, the provincial government of Kasai-Central is being questioned about the lack of official assistance to the families of the victims and about the results of the accident.

data.title: Football: huit stades retenus pour accueillir le championnat Illicocash Ligue 1 (2026-2027)
data.description: La Fédération congolaise de football association (FECOFA) a dévoilé, ce vendredi 14 aout, la liste des huit stades qui accueilleront les rencontres du championnat national Illicocash Ligue 1 pour la saison 2026-2027. Parmi les infrastructures retenues figure le mythique stade Tata Raphaël de Kinshasa, véritable temple du football congolais, qui continuera d'abriter les grandes affiches du championnat.
data.translatedTitle: Football: eight stadiums selected to host the Illicocash Ligue 1 championship (2026-2027)
data.translatedDescription: The Congolese Federation of Association Football (FECOFA) unveiled, this Friday, August 14, the list of eight stadiums which will host the matches of the Illicocash Ligue 1 national championship for the 2026-2027 season. Among the infrastructures selected is the legendary Tata Raphaël stadium in Kinshasa, a true temple of Congolese football, which will continue to house the major posters of the championship.

data.title: Journée internationale de la jeunesse : Félix Tshisekedi reçoit de Grâce Émie Kutino « le cahier des charges de la jeunesse congolaise »
data.translatedTitle: International Youth Day: Félix Tshisekedi receives from Grace Émie Kutino “the specifications for Congolese youth”

data.title: Bukavu : un incendie prive près de 300 artisans de leur centre de formation et ateliers de travail
data.description: Près de 300 artisans encadrés par la Confédération du monde de l’artisanat (CMA) se retrouvent sans espace de travail après l’incendie qui a ravagé leur centre dans la soirée du jeudi 13 août sur l’avenue Industrielle, à Bukavu, au Sud-Kivu. Le sinistre a détruit 64 ateliers et occasionné des pertes estimées à plus de 700 000 dollars américains, selon les responsables de la structure.
data.translatedTitle: Bukavu: a fire deprives nearly 300 artisans of their training center and work workshops
data.translatedDescription: Nearly 300 artisans supervised by the Confederation of the World of Crafts (CMA) found themselves without a work space after the fire which ravaged their center on the evening of Thursday August 13 on Industrielle Avenue, in Bukavu, South Kivu. The disaster destroyed 64 workshops and caused losses estimated at more than 700,000 US dollars, according to those responsible for the structure.

data.title: Journée de la jeunesse à Goma : Isabelle Pendeza invite les jeunes à s'informer, se former et rechercher les opportunités
data.description: En République démocratique du Congo, le numérique constitue une passerelle vers l'emploi, l'autonomie financière et l'entrepreneuriat pour les jeunes. Dans un contexte marqué par l'instabilité politique et sécuritaire, les outils numériques représentent, pour de nombreux jeunes Congolais, un moyen de contourner les barrières géographiques et les lenteurs administratives traditionnelles.
data.translatedTitle: Youth Day in Goma: Isabelle Pendeza invites young people to get information, train and seek opportunities
data.translatedDescription: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, digital technology constitutes a gateway to employment, financial autonomy and entrepreneurship for young people. In a context marked by political and security instability, digital tools represent, for many young Congolese, a means of circumventing geographical barriers and traditional administrative delays.

data.title: L'armée repousse une incursion attribuée aux ADF à Mambasa
data.description: Une incursion attribuée aux rebelles des Forces démocratiques alliées (ADF) a été signalée dans la soirée du jeudi 13 août à la périphérie de Mambasa-centre, en territoire de Mambasa, dans la province de l’Ituri. L’intervention rapide des Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC), appuyées par les Casques bleus de la MONUSCO, a permis de repousser les assaillants après plusieurs échanges de tirs.
data.translatedTitle: The army repels an incursion attributed to the ADF in Mambasa
data.translatedDescription: An incursion attributed to Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) rebels was reported on the evening of Thursday, August 13 on the outskirts of Mambasa-center, in Mambasa territory, in Ituri province. The rapid intervention of the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC), supported by MONUSCO peacekeepers, made it possible to repel the attackers after several exchanges of fire.

data.title: Best of the Best 9 : les 14 candidats ont relevé le défi « Tu devras livrer bataille »
data.description: Ils ne sont plus que 14 candidats en compétition. Ce jeudi 13 août 2026, ils ont concouru au Gymnase de la Police dans le cadre du cinquième Prime de la neuvième édition de Best of the Best. Pour ce nouveau rendez-vous, les participants ont été soumis à des confrontations directes autour du thème : « Tu devras livrer bataille ». La compétition a notamment opposé l'équipe de Gally Garvey à celle de Gaz Mawete. Les deux mentors, présents depuis le début de l'aventure, poursuivent l'accompagnement des candidats dans leur évolution artistique. Au cours de ces confrontations, chaque candidat a su se démarquer par son interprétation, sa présence scénique, son identité artistique et sa capacité à convaincre face à son adversaire.
data.translatedTitle: Best of the Best 9: the 14 candidates took up the challenge “You will have to fight”
data.translatedDescription: There are only 14 candidates left in competition. This Thursday, August 13, 2026, they competed at the Police Gymnase as part of the fifth Prime of the ninth edition of Best of the Best. For this new meeting, the participants were subjected to direct confrontations around the theme: “You will have to fight a battle”. The competition notably pitted Gally Garvey's team against that of Gaz Mawete. The two mentors, present since the start of the adventure, continue to support the candidates in their artistic development. During these confrontations, each candidate was able to stand out through their interpretation, their stage presence, their artistic identity and their ability to convince in the face of their opponent.

data.title: Plus de 60 familles pygmées déplacées vivent sans nourriture ni abris suffisants à Beni
data.description: 67 ménages de la communauté autochtone pygmée, soit environ 200 personnes déplacées par les violences attribuées aux ADF, vivent dans des conditions difficiles à Beni, au Nord-Kivu. Ces familles affirment avoir fui leur site de Ngadi, en périphérie de la ville, après une attaque survenue fin mai, et ont été installées provisoirement à Boikene.
data.translatedTitle: More than 60 displaced Pygmy families live without sufficient food or shelter in Beni
data.translatedDescription: 67 households from the indigenous Pygmy community, or around 200 people displaced by violence attributed to the ADF, live in difficult conditions in Beni, North Kivu. These families claim to have fled their site in Ngadi, on the outskirts of the city, after an attack at the end of May, and were temporarily installed in Boikene.

data.title: La malnutrition touche 37,6 % des enfants de moins de cinq ans au Kasaï-Oriental ( PRONANUT)
data.translatedTitle: Malnutrition affects 37.6% of children under five in Kasaï-Oriental (PRONANUT)

data.title: Le langage de l’intelligence artificielle
data.description: Chers internautes, L’intelligence artificielle est-elle simplement un outil au service de l’humanité ou influence-t-elle déjà notre manière de comprendre le monde, de nous informer et même de communiquer ? Dans ce nouvel épisode de « C’est le ton qui fait la panique », nous nous intéressons au langage de l’intelligence artificielle, une technologie qui occupe désormais une place importante dans notre vie quotidienne.
data.translatedTitle: The language of artificial intelligence
data.translatedDescription: Dear Internet users, Is artificial intelligence simply a tool at the service of humanity or does it already influence our way of understanding the world, of informing ourselves and even of communicating? In this new episode of “It’s the tone that causes panic”, we are interested in the language of artificial intelligence, a technology which now occupies an important place in our daily lives.

data.title: Le maire de Matadi intensifie la sensibilisation au prochain recensement général de la population
data.description: La mairie de Matadi, dans le Kongo-Central, intensifie la sensibilisation de la population en prélude au prochain recensement général de la population et de l’habitat. Depuis le début de la semaine, le maire Dominique Nkodia a multiplié les réunions avec les bourgmestres, les chefs de quartiers et les responsables d’avenues afin de préparer le déploiement des équipes sur le terrain.
data.translatedTitle: The Mayor of Matadi intensifies awareness of the next general population census
data.translatedDescription: The town hall of Matadi, in Kongo-Central, is intensifying awareness among the population as a prelude to the next general population and housing census. Since the start of the week, Mayor Dominique Nkodia has held numerous meetings with mayors, district leaders and avenue managers in order to prepare the deployment of teams on the ground.

data.title: Accords de Washington : la RDC et le Rwanda proposent deux initiatives pour renforcer le suivi sécuritaire
data.description: La République démocratique du Congo et le Rwanda veulent renforcer le suivi et la vérification de la mise en œuvre des Accords de Washington. Deux initiatives en ce sens ont été présentées à l’issue de la sixième réunion du Mécanisme conjoint de coordination de la sécurité, tenue les 12 et 13 août à Genève.
data.translatedTitle: Washington agreements: the DRC and Rwanda propose two initiatives to strengthen security monitoring
data.translatedDescription: The Democratic Republic of Congo and Rwanda want to strengthen monitoring and verification of the implementation of the Washington Agreements. Two initiatives in this direction were presented following the sixth meeting of the Joint Security Coordination Mechanism, held on August 12 and 13 in Geneva.

data.title: Ebola : des contrôles sanitaires insuffisants sur les axes Mahagi-Kisangani (société civile)
data.description: Les dispositifs de contrôle sanitaire et de prévention contre Ebola restent insuffisants sur les routes nationales 4 et 27, deux axes reliant Mahagi à Komanda, en Ituri, puis Komanda à Kisangani, dans la Tshopo, s’est indignée jeudi 13 août, la société civile de Bunia.
data.translatedTitle: Ebola: insufficient health checks on the Mahagi-Kisangani axes (civil society)
data.translatedDescription: Health control and prevention systems against Ebola remain insufficient on national roads 4 and 27, two axes linking Mahagi to Komanda, in Ituri, then Komanda to Kisangani, in Tshopo, the civil society of Bunia was outraged on Thursday August 13.

data.title: Le Gouvernement et l'UNESCO lancent un programme pour réintégrer 4 200 enfants non scolarisés dans le système éducatif
data.description: Le Gouvernement et UNESCO ont lancé jeudi 13 août à Kinshasa un nouveau Projet d’intégration des enfants non scolarisés dans l’enseignement formel par l’apprentissage accéléré. Soutenue financièrement par le Japon, cette initiative vise à offrir une seconde chance à des milliers d’enfants congolais déscolarisés ou n’ayant jamais fréquenté l’école. Selon l’UNESCO, 6,6 millions d'enfants en RDC sont encore privés de leur droit a l'éducation.
data.translatedTitle: The Government and UNESCO launch a program to reintegrate 4,200 out-of-school children into the education system
data.translatedDescription: The Government and UNESCO launched on Thursday August 13 in Kinshasa a new Project for the integration of out-of-school children into formal education through accelerated learning. Financially supported by Japan, this initiative aims to offer a second chance to thousands of Congolese children who have dropped out of school or have never attended school. According to UNESCO, 6.6 million children in the DRC are still deprived of their right to education.

data.title: Pénurie de médicaments et manque de personnel au centre de santé de référence de Kayuyu au Maniema
data.description: Le centre de santé de référence de Kayuyu, dans le secteur de Wakabango 2, territoire de Pangi au Maniema, fait face à d’importantes difficultés de fonctionnement. La structure manque notamment de médicaments, d’équipements et de personnel médical. L’alerte est lancée jeudi 13 août, par le chef de secteur de Wakabango 2, Ngumbi Kalokola Prince, qui appelle les autorités provinciales à intervenir en urgence pour améliorer la prise en charge des patients.
data.translatedTitle: Shortage of medicines and lack of staff at the Kayuyu reference health center in Maniema
data.translatedDescription: The Kayuyu reference health center, in the Wakabango 2 sector, Pangi territory in Maniema, is facing significant operating difficulties. The structure notably lacks medicines, equipment and medical staff. The alert was launched Thursday, August 13, by the sector head of Wakabango 2, Ngumbi Kalokola Prince, who calls on the provincial authorities to intervene urgently to improve patient care.

data.title: Ebola : le personnel soignant en grève dans les centres de Nizi et Kasenyi faute de paiement
data.description: La prise en charge des malades d’Ebola est perturbée dans deux centres de traitement en Ituri. À Nizi, dans le territoire de Djugu, et à Kasenyi (Ituri), sur les rives du lac Albert. Des prestataires de santé ont suspendu depuis mercredi 12 août leurs activités pour réclamer le paiement de plusieurs mois d’arriérés de primes.
data.translatedTitle: Ebola: healthcare workers on strike in Nizi and Kasenyi centers for lack of payment
data.translatedDescription: The care of Ebola patients is disrupted in two treatment centers in Ituri. In Nizi, in the territory of Djugu, and in Kasenyi (Ituri), on the shores of Lake Albert. Health providers have suspended their activities since Wednesday August 12 to demand payment of several months of premium arrears.

data.title: Le gouverneur du Sud-Kivu mise sur la relance des usines de Bwegera et Kiliba pour réduire les importations alimentaires
data.description: Le gouverneur du Sud-Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, veut réduire la dépendance de la province aux importations de produits alimentaires. Il mise notamment sur la relance des activités agricoles et industrielles dans les zones de Bwegera et Kiliba, dans le territoire d’Uvira.
data.translatedTitle: The governor of South Kivu is banking on the revival of Bwegera and Kiliba factories to reduce food imports
data.translatedDescription: The governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, wants to reduce the province's dependence on food imports. It focuses in particular on the revival of agricultural and industrial activities in the areas of Bwegera and Kiliba, in the territory of Uvira.

data.title: En RDC, une femme sur deux en âge de procréer souffre d’anémie, selon le PRONANUT
data.description: L’anémie demeure un problème majeur de santé publique en République démocratique du Congo. Environ 51 % des femmes en âge de procréer sont touchées par cette affection à travers le pays, selon la Directrice du Programme national de nutrition (PRONANUT). Ce chiffre a été présenté jeudi13 aout à Kinshasa lors d’un briefing de presse consacré à la supplémentation en micronutriments.
data.translatedTitle: In the DRC, one in two women of childbearing age suffers from anemia, according to PRONANUT
data.translatedDescription: Anemia remains a major public health problem in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Around 51% of women of childbearing age are affected by this condition across the country, according to the Director of the National Nutrition Program (PRONANUT). This figure was presented on Thursday August 13 in Kinshasa during a press briefing dedicated to micronutrient supplementation.

data.title: 7sur7 : Loi sur le référendum, Félix Tshisekedi sollicite une nouvelle délibération au Parlement
data.description: Deux actualités dominent les unes des journaux parus ce matin dans la capitale congolaise : d’une part, le rebondissement institutionnel autour de la loi sur le référendum, renvoyée par le chef de l’État au Parlement pour une nouvelle délibération ; d’autre part, la clarification de la position de la Coalition Article 64 à la veille de l’échéance du 15 août.
data.translatedTitle: 7sur7: Referendum law, Félix Tshisekedi requests a new deliberation in Parliament
data.translatedDescription: Two news stories dominate the front pages of the newspapers published this morning in the Congolese capital: on the one hand, the institutional twist around the law on the referendum, sent back by the Head of State to Parliament for a new deliberation; on the other hand, the clarification of the position of the Article 64 Coalition on the eve of the August 15 deadline.

data.title: POS Foundation raises alarm over student cohabitation, sexual harassment on university campuses
data.description:
The Perfector of Sentiments (POS) Foundation has raised concerns over student cohabitation and sexual harassment in some of Ghana’s public universities, warning that the practices could undermine efforts to create safe learning environments.

The human rights organisation says cohabitation among students can contribute to domestic conflicts and, in some cases, escalate into physical or sexual abuse.

data.title: Gushegu MCE says slain Yiidana was targeted as police investigate killing of chief and son
data.description:
The Municipal Chief Executive for Gushegu, Abdul Hafiz Adam, says the killing of a Yiidana and his son at the chief’s palace was a targeted assassination and not the beginning of wider communal violence.

He has urged residents to remain calm as security agencies investigate the attack and work to identify and arrest those responsible.

Mr Adam told MyJoyOnline that three gunmen entered the palace at about 11 p.m. on Tuesday and initially confronted young men outside the residence.

data.title: TEWU gives government two weeks to address non-teaching staff grievances or face industrial action
data.description:
The Teachers and Educational Workers’ Union (TEWU) of TUC (Ghana) has given government and education authorities a two-week ultimatum to address what it describes as persistent discrimination and poor working conditions affecting non-teaching staff across the education sector.

The Union said failure to resolve its eight key demands by the end of the two-week period could trigger industrial action.

In a statement issued on Friday, August 14, TEWU cited delayed remuneration, unfair labour practices, limited career progression, inadequate recognition and staff shortages among the concerns affecting its members.

data.title: Nene Tek returns: a new chapter, a deeper sound and a bigger vision
data.description:
After taking time away from the music business, Nene Tek is back, but this is more than a return to releasing music. For the Ghanaian singer, songwriter and rapper, it is a return shaped by life, family, loss, growth and a renewed sense of purpose.

Known for his ability to move between singing, songwriting and rap, Nene Tek stepped away from the industry to find himself and reconnect with family. That time away took him back to where he grew up, an experience he says taught him important lessons about life.

“Life hit me hard, so I took some time to find myself and also have time with family,” he explains. The year has also brought personal loss, with the passing of important members of his family, forcing him to reflect on what truly matters. At the same time, a connection with his cousin in the UK brought fresh encouragement and support for his music.

data.title: Peace Council urges restraint over religious controversies to prevent tensions
data.description:
The National Peace Council (NPC) has urged Ghanaians to exercise restraint and avoid conflating two separate incidents that have recently attracted public attention, warning that inflammatory commentary could threaten religious and communal harmony.

In a statement issued on Thursday, August 13, the Council said the two matters involved separate circumstances and should not be treated as one incident.

The first concerns the arrest of two religious clerics over alleged inflammatory and offensive remarks about Prophet Mohammed, while the second relates to footage circulating on social media showing a person restrained in handcuffs in the presence of individuals associated with law enforcement.

The Council said the sensitive religious dimension of the developments required responsible public discourse.

data.title: Díaz-Canel visita Zona de Defensa en Guanabacoa y llama a fortalecer capacidades locales ante situaciones adversas

data.title: Maldonado tras alianza HCH, GOTV y DIEZ: "Esto no es para dividir, es para impulsar"
data.description: El director y dueño de HCH, Eduardo Maldonado , confirmó una nueva etapa en materia de transmisiones deportivas tras concretarse una alianza con Grupo OPSA para llevar a los aficionados los partidos del Génesis FC. El empresario agradeció al señor Gustavo Sánchez , a quien señaló como una pieza clave para hacer posible este proyecto. Maldonado explicó que la iniciativa busca fortalecer a los equipos de diferentes regiones del país y generar mayor respaldo para el fútbol hondureño. En ese sentido, destacó la importancia de que los aficionados apoyen a los clubes de sus departamentos y zonas. "Bueno, en primer lugar, gracias al señor Gustavo Sánchez, que a través de él hemos logrado iniciar esta otra etapa que esperamos, en el nombre de Dios, salgamos bien. Gracias porque él ha sido una pieza clave", manifestó el director y dueño de HCH. El empresario también confirmó que la transmisión del Génesis FC forma parte de este nuevo proyecto y adelantó que existe otro club con el que las conversaciones están bastante avanzadas. Se trata del Independiente de Siguatepeque, equipo que también podría contar con las transmisiones de HCH y Grupo OPSA. "Bueno, pues, quiero agradecer porque yo he estado conversando con el señor Gustavo Sánchez y creo que él le puede oficializar o confirmar que nosotros vamos a transmitir el equipo. Estamos ya también en este proceso ya casi oficial con el equipo Independiente de la zona central de Honduras, de Siguatepeque, y quien más quiera", expresó Maldonado. La intención, según explicó, no es generar divisiones, sino impulsar a los clubes y brindarles herramientas para que tengan mayor exposición. Maldonado incluso planteó que en el futuro cada departamento pueda contar con un canal que acompañe y promueva a sus equipos y otras actividades deportivas. "Esto no es para dividir, esto es para impulsar más bien que cada equipo tenga su, ojalá que un día llegáramos a ti, compañero Alex, Claudia y Carolina y don Gustavo Sánchez, que un día cada departamento tuviese su canal que lo impulsara a su equipo, y no solo el equipo, sino de fútbol, sino cualquier otra actividad deportiva", agregó. El dueño de HCH también adelantó que los aficionados podrán disfrutar de una propuesta diferente durante las transmisiones, con contenido especial antes y después de los partidos. Además, dejó entrever que habrá regalos y sorpresas para quienes acompañen a sus equipos desde la pantalla. "El amigo Gustavo Sánchez creo que iba a anunciar también algún regalo, porque esto va a ser distinto, ambiente antes y ambiente después de cada partido, que el pueblo como tal celebre sin pleitos, sin nada, los éxitos de su equipo, y también aceptar que no todo el tiempo es ganar, sino que también a veces empata y se pierde", comentó. Maldonado aprovechó el anuncio para destacar el respaldo de Grupo OPSA y elogiar especialmente el trabajo de DIARIO DIEZ, El Heraldo, LA PRENSA y GOTV, resaltando la importancia que tienen estos medios en la cobertura deportiva y en las plataformas digitales del país. También reconoció el papel de Rodrigo Canahuati durante el proceso. "Estoy contento de reiterarles que HCH sigue siendo el canal cien por ciento de noticias, agradecer a los amigos de esta enorme empresa de TV y Diario Diez, que es el canal, diría yo, o es el periódico, o el suplemento, como usted quiera, más completo de deportes en el país. Quiero reconocer que Rodrigo Canahuati ha sido una pieza clave para todo este proceso", señaló. Finalmente, Eduardo Maldonado aseguró que esta alianza representa una nueva etapa y expresó su deseo de que en el futuro exista mayor apertura para las transmisiones deportivas, incluso cuando juegue la Selección de Honduras. Su propuesta es que los aficionados tengan la posibilidad de elegir en qué canal desean seguir los partidos. "Soy de los que creo que aspiramos, no sé si don Gustavo Sánchez, que me están escuchando, están de acuerdo, aspiramos que cuando juegue la selección, todos podamos ser partícipes de los derechos para transmitir, y que cada quien haga lo suyo, para que el televidente escoja en qué canal quiere ver, por ejemplo, un partido de la selección", concluyó Maldonado.
data.translatedTitle: Maldonado after HCH, GOTV and DIEZ alliance: "This is not to divide, it is to promote"
data.translatedDescription: The director and owner of HCH, Eduardo Maldonado, confirmed a new stage in sports broadcasting after establishing an alliance with Grupo OPSA to bring Génesis FC matches to fans. The businessman thanked Mr. Gustavo Sánchez, whom he pointed out as a key player in making this project possible. Maldonado explained that the initiative seeks to strengthen teams from different regions of the country and generate greater support for Honduran soccer. In that sense, he highlighted the importance of fans supporting the clubs in their departments and areas. "Well, first of all, thanks to Mr. Gustavo Sánchez, who through him we have managed to start this other stage that we hope, in the name of God, we turn out well. Thank you because he has been a key piece," said the director and owner of HCH. The businessman also confirmed that the transmission of Génesis FC is part of this new project and announced that there is another club with which conversations are quite advanced. This is Independiente de Siguatepeque, a team that could also count on the transmissions of HCH and Grupo OPSA. "Well, I want to thank you because I have been talking with Mr. Gustavo Sánchez and I think he can make it official or confirm that we are going to transmit the team. We are also already in this almost official process with the Independiente team from the central zone of Honduras, from Siguatepeque, and whoever else wants it," said Maldonado. The intention, as he explained, is not to generate divisions, but to encourage the clubs and provide them with tools so that they have greater exposure. Maldonado even proposed that in the future each department could have a channel that accompanies and promotes its teams and other sports activities. "This is not to divide, this is to promote rather that each team has its own, I hope that one day we would come to you, partner Alex, Claudia and Carolina and Don Gustavo Sánchez, that one day each department would have its channel that would promote its team, and not only the team, but football, but any other sporting activity," he added. The owner of HCH also announced that fans will be able to enjoy a different proposal during the broadcasts, with special content before and after the games. In addition, he hinted that there will be gifts and surprises for those who accompany their teams from the screen. "I think my friend Gustavo Sánchez was also going to announce a gift, because this is going to be different, the atmosphere before and the atmosphere after each game, that the people as such celebrate without disputes, without anything, the successes of their team, and also accept that not all the time is winning, but that sometimes they draw and lose," he commented. Maldonado took advantage of the announcement to highlight the support of Grupo OPSA and especially praise the work of DIARIO DIEZ, El Heraldo, LA PRENSA and GOTV, highlighting the importance that these media have in sports coverage and on the country's digital platforms. He also recognized the role of Rodrigo Canahuati during the process. "I am happy to reiterate that HCH continues to be the 100% news channel, to thank the friends of this enormous TV company and Diario Diez, which is the channel, I would say, or is the newspaper, or the supplement, as you wish, most complete on sports in the country. I want to recognize that Rodrigo Canahuati has been a key piece for this entire process," he said. Finally, Eduardo Maldonado assured that this alliance represents a new stage and expressed his desire that in the future there will be greater openness for sports broadcasts, even when the Honduran National Team plays. Their proposal is that fans have the possibility of choosing which channel they want to follow the games on. "I am one of those who believe that we aspire, I don't know if Don Gustavo Sánchez, who is listening to me, agrees, we aspire that when the national team plays, we can all be participants in the rights to broadcast, and that everyone does their own thing, so that the viewer can choose which channel they want to watch, for example, a national team match," Maldonado concluded.

data.title: Muere policía en accidente de tránsito en carretera de Yoro
data.description: Una agente de la Policía Nacional murió este viernes en un accidente de tránsito registrado en la carretera RN-23, a la altura de la aldea Vueltas de Chancaya, en el departamento de Yoro. La víctima fue identificada como Delsy Maribel Hernández Hernández , quien se desempeñaba como Clase I de Policía y estaba asignada a la Jefatura Municipal de El Negrito, Yoro, según el reporte preliminar de la Policía Nacional. El accidente ocurrió en el segmento carretero Morazán-Habana y fue reportado como un despiste, en el que se vio involucrado el vehículo que conducía la funcionaria policial. De acuerdo con el informe policial, agentes que realizaban labores de patrullaje localizaron el vehículo accidentado y confirmaron que en el hecho había una persona del sexo femenino sin vida. El vehículo involucrado es un Toyota Corolla, color rojo, tipo turismo, con placas HAX 6261, el cual quedó con daños materiales producto del accidente. Hernández Hernández era originaria de La Paz y formaba parte activa de la Policía Nacional. Al momento del accidente estaba asignada a la Jefatura Municipal de El Negrito, de acuerdo con la información proporcionada por la UDEP-18. Las autoridades correspondientes realizaron las primeras diligencias en la escena para establecer cómo ocurrió el despiste y determinar las circunstancias que provocaron el fatal accidente.
data.translatedTitle: Policeman dies in traffic accident on Yoro highway
data.translatedDescription: A National Police agent died this Friday in a traffic accident on the RN-23 highway, near the village of Vueltas de Chancaya, in the department of Yoro. The victim was identified as Delsy Maribel Hernández Hernández, who worked as Police Class I and was assigned to the Municipal Headquarters of El Negrito, Yoro, according to the preliminary report of the National Police. The accident occurred on the Morazán-Habana highway segment and was reported as a mistake, in which the vehicle driven by the police officer was involved. According to the police report, agents carrying out patrol duties located the crashed vehicle and confirmed that there was a lifeless female person in the incident. The vehicle involved is a red Toyota Corolla, passenger type, with HAX 6261 plates, which was left with material damage as a result of the accident. Hernández Hernández was originally from La Paz and was an active part of the National Police. At the time of the accident, she was assigned to the Municipal Headquarters of El Negrito, according to the information provided by the UDEP-18. The corresponding authorities carried out the first steps at the scene to establish how the mistake occurred and determine the circumstances that caused the fatal accident.

data.title: Presidente del Génesis revela sorpresas tras alianza entre HCH, DIEZ y GOTV
data.description: El presidente del Génesis FC, Gustavo Sánchez, habló en exclusiva con DIARIO LA PRENSA sobre la expectativa que ha generado la alianza estratégica entre HCH y DIARIO DIEZ (GO TV) para la transmisión del partido entre Génesis y Platense , que se disputará este sábado 15 de agosto a las 3:00 de la tarde en el Estadio Roberto Suazo Córdova. Sánchez reconoció que la estrategia de mantener en secreto el acuerdo generó una gran expectativa entre los aficionados y destacó el anuncio realizado por HCH durante la mañana de este viernes. “Había que crear expectativas, lo hicieron muy bien ustedes, lo hizo muy bien Eduardo Maldonado . Y hoy HCH lo anunció en horas de la mañana. Es un boom, las redes fueron una locura, a mí me preguntaban, pero no podía comentar nada sobre esta alianza estratégica”, expresó. El dirigente confirmó que todo está listo para el esperado encuentro frente al conjunto de Puerto Cortés. “Arrancamos mañana a las 3 de la tarde en el Roberto Suazo Córdova. Y vamos a enfrentar al Platense de Puerto Cortés”, señaló Sánchez, quien espera que el escenario deportivo pueda vivir una jornada especial con la presencia de los aficionados. Además del atractivo futbolístico, Génesis FC ha preparado una serie de premios para quienes asistan al compromiso. El presidente del club adelantó que habrá rifas durante la jornada y una motocicleta será sorteada al finalizar el encuentro. “Hay muchas sorpresas mañana de premios. Mañana a las 12 del mediodía va a estar abierto. Van a haber varias rifas: una motocicleta al final del partido. Se va a rifar una tablet, camisetas oficiales del equipo y electrodomésticos. Todo se hará entre las personas que adquieran sus boletos”, explicó el máximo dirigente del equipo. Sánchez también recordó la campaña anterior, en la que el equipo se quedó cerca de disputar la gran final, situación que elevó las expectativas para el nuevo torneo. “El año pasado nosotros quedamos con un buen sabor de boca, quedamos a un gol de la final, nos enfrentamos al Motagua , pero al final la plantilla se impuso. Quedamos picados, renovamos al profesor Fernando Mira , un técnico muy profesional”, comentó. El presidente reveló que el club realizó diez incorporaciones y apostó también por jóvenes futbolistas. “Se decidieron hacer diez incorporaciones, ahora tenemos un plantel de lujo. Tenemos una plantilla muy rígida. Esperamos ganar contra Platense, queremos llegar a liguilla”, manifestó. Asimismo, destacó la confianza que existe en el trabajo de Fernando Mira y aseguró que el entrenador cuenta con libertad para tomar decisiones futbolísticas. “Es una exigencia enorme, la vara está alta. Hicimos una inversión importante, trajimos chicos de buen nivel, hicimos debutar a ocho jóvenes. Obviamente le dimos prioridad al profesor Fernando Mira. Estamos bien, estoy feliz con el equipo que tenemos. Yo no influyo en el equipo, conozco poco técnicamente hablando de fútbol. Mira tiene la libertad del mundo”, afirmó Sánchez. Finalmente, el dirigente explicó que el proyecto del Génesis va más allá del primer equipo y busca desarrollar talento en diferentes categorías y países. “Génesis tiene primera división, cuatro categorías en Liga Mayor, Liga Femenil, tenemos academias en La Paz y Tegucigalpa. Acabamos de lanzar una academia en Estados Unidos, en Virginia. Tenemos a otros chicos en España y otros en New Jersey. Queremos encontrar ese talento en diferentes partes del mundo”, dijo. Además, invitó a conocer La Paz y destacó sus tradiciones: “La Paz es mucho más que fútbol. El paceño es muy amable, cariñoso y cordial. Recibe al visitante como que fuera un amigo. En noviembre se celebra la Feria Patronal de La Paz. Hay muchas familias por generaciones que han pasado por la elaboración. Tenemos muchos lugares para visitar”.
data.translatedTitle: President of Génesis reveals surprises after alliance between HCH, DIEZ and GOTV
data.translatedDescription: The president of Génesis FC, Gustavo Sánchez, spoke exclusively with DIARIO LA PRENSA about the expectation generated by the strategic alliance between HCH and DIARIO DIEZ (GO TV) for the broadcast of the match between Génesis and Platense, which will be played this Saturday, August 15 at 3:00 in the afternoon at the Roberto Suazo Córdova Stadium. Sánchez acknowledged that the strategy of keeping the agreement secret generated great expectations among fans and highlighted the announcement made by HCH this Friday morning. "We had to create expectations, you did it very well, Eduardo Maldonado did it very well. And today HCH announced it in the morning. It's a boom, the networks were crazy, they asked me, but I couldn't comment anything about this strategic alliance," he expressed. The leader confirmed that everything is ready for the long-awaited match against the Puerto Cortés team. "We start tomorrow at 3 in the afternoon at the Roberto Suazo Córdova. And we are going to face the Platense of Puerto Cortés," said Sánchez, who hopes that the sports scene can experience a special day with the presence of the fans. In addition to the football attraction, Génesis FC has prepared a series of prizes for those who attend the event. The president of the club announced that there will be raffles during the day and a motorcycle will be raffled off at the end of the meeting. "There are many surprises tomorrow with prizes. Tomorrow at 12 noon it will be open. There will be several raffles: a motorcycle at the end of the game. A tablet, official team t-shirts and appliances will be raffled off. Everything will be done among the people who purchase their tickets," explained the team's top leader. Sánchez also recalled the previous campaign, in which the team came close to playing in the grand final, a situation that raised expectations for the new tournament. "Last year we left with a good taste in our mouths, we were one goal away from the final, we faced Motagua, but in the end the squad prevailed. We were stung, we renewed Professor Fernando Mira, a very professional coach," he commented. The president revealed that the club made ten additions and also opted for young footballers. "They decided to make ten additions, now we have a luxury squad. We have a very rigid squad. We hope to win against Platense, we want to reach the league," he said. Likewise, he highlighted the trust that exists in Fernando Mira's work and assured that the coach has the freedom to make football decisions. "It is an enormous demand, the bar is high. We made a significant investment, we brought good-level kids, we gave eight young people their debut. Obviously we gave priority to Professor Fernando Mira. We are fine, I am happy with the team we have. I do not influence the team, I know little technically speaking about football. Mira has the freedom of the world," said Sánchez. Finally, the leader explained that the Genesis project goes beyond the first team and seeks to develop talent in different categories and countries. "Génesis has the first division, four categories in the Major League, the Women's League, we have academies in La Paz and Tegucigalpa. We have just launched an academy in the United States, in Virginia. We have other kids in Spain and others in New Jersey. We want to find that talent in different parts of the world," he said. In addition, he invited people to get to know La Paz and highlighted its traditions: "La Paz is much more than football. The people of La Paz are very kind, affectionate and cordial. They receive the visitor as if they were a friend. In November, the La Paz Patron Fair is celebrated. There are many families for generations who have gone through the making. We have many places to visit."

data.title: Baches y calles deterioradas complican el tránsito en el centro sampedrano
data.description: Baches de distintos tamaños deterioran calles y avenidas de sectores céntricos de San Pedro Sula , obligando a conductores de vehículos particulares y del transporte público a realizar maniobras para esquivarlos y evitar daños en llantas, rines y sistemas de suspensión. El mal estado de las vías se ha convertido en una dificultad cotidiana para quienes circulan por estas zonas. Conductores, peatones y comerciantes han llamado en distintas ocasiones a las autoridades para que se atienda el deterioro de las calles. Durante un recorrido realizado por LA PRENSA se constató la presencia de numerosos agujeros y tramos deteriorados que dificultan la circulación , especialmente cuando los conductores deben reducir la velocidad o cambiar de trayectoria para evitar caer en los baches. Jorge Meras, uno de los ciudadanos consultados, señaló que el problema no es reciente y que las condiciones de las vías han empeorado con el paso de los años. “Este es un problema que viene de años, nada nuevo ni reciente, pero cada día se ve peor. Los motoristas tienen que esquivar o ver cómo hacen para cuidar sus vehículos ; hasta los mismos choferes de buses rapiditos tienen que maniobrar”, manifestó. El deterioro de las calles se suma a otros problemas que afectan a quienes permanecen o transitan por estos sectores. Cuando llueve, el agua se acumula en los baches y genera condiciones que dificultan identificar la profundidad de los agujeros. Además, vecinos y comerciantes señalan la presencia de malos olores provenientes del agua estancada. El problema también se presenta cuando establecimientos cercanos realizan labores de limpieza y el agua termina corriendo hacia las calles , donde permanece acumulada debido a las condiciones de la superficie. Ante la falta de reparación, algunos pobladores han recurrido a soluciones improvisadas. Durante el recorrido se observó que ciertos baches han sido rellenados con basura y desperdicios de construcción. La intención, según los usuarios, es disminuir la profundidad de los hoyos y evitar que los vehículos sufran daños al pasar por ellos. Las dificultades también alcanzan a quienes se movilizan a pie. En algunos puntos, las aceras se encuentran ocupadas por vendedores informales, lo que obliga a los peatones a caminar por la calle. De esta manera, conductores y peatones terminan compartiendo un espacio reducido, aumentando las dificultades para circular. Los ciudadanos esperan que las autoridades municipales atiendan las calles que presentan mayor deterioro y que se busquen soluciones tanto para los baches como para los problemas de drenaje y ocupación de las aceras.
data.translatedTitle: Potholes and deteriorated streets complicate traffic in the center of San Pedro
data.translatedDescription: Potholes of different sizes deteriorate streets and avenues in central sectors of San Pedro Sula, forcing drivers of private vehicles and public transportation to perform maneuvers to avoid them and avoid damage to tires, wheels and suspension systems. The poor condition of the roads has become a daily difficulty for those who travel through these areas. Drivers, pedestrians and merchants have called the authorities on different occasions to address the deterioration of the streets. During a tour carried out by LA PRENSA, the presence of numerous holes and deteriorated sections that make circulation difficult, especially when drivers must reduce speed or change path to avoid falling into potholes. Jorge Meras, one of the citizens consulted, pointed out that the problem is not recent and that the conditions of the roads have worsened over the years. "This is a problem that has been going on for years, nothing new or recent, but it looks worse every day. Motorists have to dodge or see how they can take care of their vehicles; even the fast bus drivers themselves have to maneuver," he said. The deterioration of the streets adds to other problems that affect those who remain or pass through these sectors. When it rains, water accumulates in potholes and creates conditions that make it difficult to identify the depth of the holes. In addition, neighbors and merchants point out the presence of bad odors coming from stagnant water. The problem also occurs when nearby establishments carry out cleaning work and the water ends up running into the streets, where it remains accumulated due to the surface conditions. In the absence of repair, some residents have resorted to improvised solutions. During the tour it was observed that certain potholes have been filled with garbage and construction waste. The intention, according to users, is to reduce the depth of the holes and prevent vehicles from suffering damage when passing through them. The difficulties also reach those who move on foot. In some places, the sidewalks are occupied by informal vendors, forcing pedestrians to walk along the street. In this way, drivers and pedestrians end up sharing a small space, increasing the difficulties of moving around. Citizens expect that municipal authorities will address the streets that are most deteriorated and that solutions will be sought for both potholes and drainage and sidewalk occupation problems.

data.title: ¿Vive en una zona sísmica? Este mapa muestra dónde tiembla más en Honduras
data.description: La tierra se movió con frecuencia en Honduras durante los últimos tres años y medio , según los registros del Centro de Estudios Atmosféricos, Oceanográficos y Sísmicos (Cenaos). Aunque la mayoría de estos movimientos pasó inadvertida para la población, entre 2023 y el 2 de julio de 2026 se registraron 1,607 sismos en Honduras y sus alrededores. De estos, 587 ocurrieron dentro del territorio hondureño , con concentraciones principalmente en Cortés, Comayagua y el Golfo de Fonseca. Los datos también permiten dimensionar la magnitud de la actividad sísmica. Del total analizado, 1,092 sismos tuvieron magnitudes inferiores a 2.9 en la escala de Richter; otros 312 se ubicaron entre 3 y 3.4, mientras que 105 alcanzaron magnitudes de entre 3.5 y 3.9. Entre los movimientos de mayor magnitud registrados en el período, 76 alcanzaron niveles de moderados a fuertes. De estos, 13 tuvieron magnitudes de entre 5 y 5.4 en la escala de Richter, y solamente uno superó la magnitud 6. Los gráficos interactivos permiten explorar la distribución de estos movimientos según su ubicación, magnitud y profundidad. El análisis de la actividad sísmica en Honduras coincide con un período marcado por terremotos de gran magnitud en otros países de la región. Venezuela sufrió el 24 de junio de 2026 dos terremotos de magnitudes 7.2 y 7.5 , mientras que Colombia fue sacudida el 10 de agosto por un terremoto de magnitud 7.4 . Ambos países registraron pérdidas humanas y daños materiales. Mario Valdés, jefe de la Unidad de Sismología de Cenaos, explicó que parte de la actividad sísmica del norte está relacionada con el contacto entre las placas de Norteamérica y del Caribe, así como el sistema de fallas de las Islas del Cisne. Aunque Honduras registra menos eventos que otros países de la región, la profundidad y la magnitud influyen en qué tanto puede sentirse un movimiento. Los mapas y gráficos muestran dónde se concentraron los sismos y qué magnitudes alcanzaron durante los últimos tres años y medio.
data.translatedTitle: Do you live in a seismic zone? This map shows where it shakes the most in Honduras
data.translatedDescription: The ground moved frequently in Honduras during the last three and a half years, according to records from the Center for Atmospheric, Oceanographic and Seismic Studies (Cenaos). Although most of these movements went unnoticed by the population, between 2023 and July 2, 2026, 1,607 earthquakes were recorded in Honduras and its surroundings. Of these, 587 occurred within Honduran territory, with concentrations mainly in Cortés, Comayagua and the Gulf of Fonseca. The data also allows us to measure the magnitude of the seismic activity. Of the total analyzed, 1,092 earthquakes had magnitudes less than 2.9 on the Richter scale; another 312 were located between 3 and 3.4, while 105 reached magnitudes between 3.5 and 3.9. Among the largest movements recorded in the period, 76 reached moderate to strong levels. Of these, 13 had magnitudes between 5 and 5.4 on the Richter scale, and only one exceeded magnitude 6. Interactive graphs allow you to explore the distribution of these movements according to their location, magnitude and depth. The analysis of seismic activity in Honduras coincides with a period marked by large earthquakes in other countries in the region. Venezuela suffered two earthquakes of magnitudes 7.2 and 7.5 on June 24, 2026, while Colombia was shaken on August 10 by a magnitude 7.4 earthquake. Both countries recorded human losses and material damage. Mario Valdés, head of the Cenaos Seismology Unit, explained that part of the seismic activity in the north is related to the contact between the North American and Caribbean plates, as well as the fault system of the Swan Islands. Although Honduras records fewer events than other countries in the region, the depth and magnitude influence how much a movement can be felt. The maps and graphs show where the earthquakes were concentrated and what magnitudes they reached during the last three and a half years.

data.title: “Su muerte es injusta”: El desgarrador mensaje de José Carlos Cardona tras la muerte de Suany Aguilera
data.description: La violencia vuelve a ensombrecer a Honduras , esta vez en la zona central. Anoche, una mujer murió de forma violenta en el sector de la salida hacia el municipio de Santa Lucía , Francisco Morazán. La víctima fue identificada como Suany Aguilera , de 35 años , quien se desempeñaba como empleada del sector bancario y residía en la zona junto a su familia. El hecho criminal ha provocado indignación entre sus allegados y conocidos. A través de redes sociales, el exministro de la Secretaría de Desarrollo Social ( Sedesol ), José Carlos Cardona , lamentó profundamente la pérdida de quien describió como una cercana amiga y una persona trabajadora. "Anoche asesinaron en la salida a Santa Lucía a mi amiga Suany Aguilera , a sus 35 años, soltera y sin hijos. Suany era una joven cristiana que trabajaba en un banco desde que cumplió los 18 años, vivía con su madre, una señora honesta que crió buenas hijas y son gente humilde y decente", manifestó Cardona en su publicación en Facebook. Según información preliminar, Suany y su hermana habían salido de su vivienda y se dirigieron hacia la colonia Kennedy para comprar comida. Desafortunadamente, cuando retornaban, fueron interceptadas por sujetos desconocidos que se transportaban en una motocicleta y las atacaron a balazos. El cuerpo de Suany quedó sin vida sobre el volante de su carro. Su hermana también sufrió heridas y fue atendida por paramédicos del Cuerpo de Bomberos, quienes posteriormente la trasladaron a un centro asistencial. Hasta el momento, las autoridades de la Policía Nacional y la Dirección Policial de Investigaciones (DPI) no han brindado un informe oficial sobre las causas del ataque ni la identidad de los perpetradores. Agentes policiales y miembros del Ministerio Público se trasladaron al lugar para realizar el levantamiento del cuerpo conforme a ley e iniciar las pesquisas correspondientes que permitan dar con el paradero de los responsables.
data.translatedTitle: “His death is unjust”: The heartbreaking message of José Carlos Cardona after the death of Suany Aguilera
data.translatedDescription: Violence once again darkens Honduras, this time in the central zone. Last night, a woman died violently in the area of ​​the exit towards the municipality of Santa Lucía, Francisco Morazán. The victim was identified as Suany Aguilera, 35 years old, who worked as an employee in the banking sector and lived in the area with her family. The criminal act has caused outrage among those close to him and acquaintances. Through social networks, the former minister of the Ministry of Social Development (Sedesol), José Carlos Cardona, deeply regretted the loss of whom he described as a close friend and a hard-working person. "Last night they murdered my friend Suany Aguilera on the way out to Santa Lucía, at 35 years old, single and without children. Suany was a young Christian who worked in a bank since she turned 18, she lived with her mother, an honest lady who raised good daughters and they are humble and decent people," Cardona said in her Facebook post. According to preliminary information, Suany and her sister had left their home and headed towards the Kennedy neighborhood to buy food. Unfortunately, when they were returning, they were intercepted by unknown individuals who were traveling on a motorcycle and attacked them with bullets. Suany's body was left lifeless on the steering wheel of his car. Her sister also suffered injuries and was treated by paramedics from the Fire Department, who later transferred her to a care center. So far, the authorities of the National Police and the Police Investigation Directorate (DPI) have not provided an official report on the causes of the attack or the identity of the perpetrators. Police officers and members of the Public Ministry went to the scene to carry out the removal of the body in accordance with the law and begin the corresponding investigations to determine the whereabouts of those responsible.

data.title: CSJ recibe nueva solicitud de extradición desde Estados Unidos
data.description: La Corte Suprema de Justicia (CSJ) conoció este viernes una nueva solicitud de extradición remitida por Estados Unidos contra un ciudadano hondureño, quien es requerido por su presunta participación en el delito de homicidio. Melvin Duarte, portavoz del Poder Judicial, informó que la solicitud fue enviada por las autoridades del estado de Pensilvania a través de los canales diplomáticos correspondientes y ya fue recibida por la CSJ. Duarte explicó que, ante el ingreso de la solicitud, el pleno de la Corte Suprema de Justicia se reunió de emergencia para abordar como único punto de agenda la designación del juez natural que conocerá el proceso. El juez natural ya fue designado y recibió el expediente correspondiente para analizar los antecedentes remitidos por las autoridades estadounidenses y determinar las acciones que correspondan dentro del proceso. Como parte del procedimiento, se emitirá la orden de captura contra el ciudadano hondureño solicitado. Una vez que sea localizado y detenido por las autoridades, podrá ser sometido al procedimiento especial de extradición establecido en Honduras. El portavoz de la CSJ aclaró que, por el momento, no se puede revelar la identidad del ciudadano requerido, debido a que todavía no ha sido capturado ni se encuentra a disposición de las autoridades. “Lo prudente es esperar que se ejecute esa orden de captura”, explicó Duarte, al señalar que posteriormente se podrán brindar detalles sobre la identidad de la persona y el caso por el que es requerida. Duarte también confirmó que se trata de un ciudadano hondureño y descartó proporcionar elementos que permitan identificarlo antes de que se concrete su detención. La Corte Suprema de Justicia permanecerá a la espera de que las autoridades ejecuten la orden de captura correspondiente. Una vez que el requerido sea puesto a disposición judicial, se activará formalmente el procedimiento especial de extradición.
data.translatedTitle: CSJ receives new extradition request from the United States
data.translatedDescription: The Supreme Court of Justice (CSJ) heard this Friday a new extradition request sent by the United States against a Honduran citizen, who is wanted for his alleged participation in the crime of homicide. Melvin Duarte, spokesperson for the Judiciary, reported that the request was sent by the authorities of the state of Pennsylvania through the corresponding diplomatic channels and has already been received by the CSJ. Duarte explained that, upon receipt of the request, the plenary session of the Supreme Court of Justice met on an emergency basis to address as the only agenda item the designation of the natural judge who will hear the process. The natural judge has already been appointed and received the corresponding file to analyze the background information sent by the US authorities and determine the corresponding actions within the process. As part of the procedure, the arrest warrant will be issued against the requested Honduran citizen. Once he is located and detained by the authorities, he may be subjected to the special extradition procedure established in Honduras. The CSJ spokesperson clarified that, for the moment, the identity of the requested citizen cannot be revealed, because he has not yet been captured nor is he at the disposal of the authorities. “The prudent thing is to wait for that arrest warrant to be executed,” Duarte explained, noting that later details about the identity of the person and the case for which they are wanted can be provided. Duarte also confirmed that he is a Honduran citizen and ruled out providing elements that would allow his identification before his arrest is made. The Supreme Court of Justice will remain waiting for the authorities to execute the corresponding arrest warrant. Once the requested person is brought to justice, the special extradition procedure will be formally activated.

data.title: Medidas sustitutivas para Bartolo Fuentes, acusado de violencia en contra de Kathia Crivelli
data.description: Medidas distintas a la prisión preventiva le fueron dictadas este viernes al exdiputado del partido Libertad y Refundación (Libre), Bartolo Fuentes , en el caso que se le sigue por el presunto delito de violencia contra la mujer. La resolución judicial fue emitida tras la conclusión de la audiencia de declaración de imputado, desarrollada en los Juzgados de Letras de lo Penal en el barrio La Granja de Comayagüela. El excongresista es procesado penalmente tras la denuncia interpuesta por la diputada del Partido Liberal, Kathia Crivelli , quien lo acusó por agresión en su perjuicio. Según consta en el expediente judicial, los hechos ocurrieron el 28 de mayo del 2025 en las instalaciones del Congreso Nacional. En esa fecha, los legisladores sostuvieron una acalorada discusión en la que, de acuerdo con la denuncia de Crivelli, Fuentes procedió a agredirla físicamente. Al término de la sesión, la judicatura programó la audiencia inicial para el próximo 27 de agosto, a las 9:00 de la mañana. En dicha comparecencia, la Fiscalía y la defensa privada evacuarán la carga probatoria para determinar si se le dicta auto de formal procesamiento o un sobreseimiento.
data.translatedTitle: Alternative measures for Bartolo Fuentes, accused of violence against Kathia Crivelli
data.translatedDescription: Measures other than preventive detention were issued this Friday to the former deputy of the Libertad y Refundación (Libre) party, Bartolo Fuentes, in the case being followed for the alleged crime of violence against women. The judicial resolution was issued after the conclusion of the defendant's declaration hearing, held in the Criminal Courts in the La Granja neighborhood of Comayagüela. The former congressman is criminally prosecuted after the complaint filed by the Liberal Party deputy, Kathia Crivelli, who accused him of assault to his detriment. According to the judicial file, the events occurred on May 28, 2025 at the facilities of the National Congress. On that date, the legislators had a heated discussion in which, according to Crivelli's complaint, Fuentes proceeded to physically attack her. At the end of the session, the judiciary scheduled the initial hearing for next August 27, at 9:00 in the morning. At said appearance, the Prosecutor's Office and the private defense will evacuate the evidentiary burden to determine whether an order for formal prosecution or a dismissal is issued.

data.title: Nuevos precios de los combustibles a partir del lunes 17 de agosto en Honduras
data.description: La Secretaría de Energía (SEN) anunció la nueva estructura de precios de los combustibles que entrará en vigencia a partir del lunes 17 de agosto de 2026 en Honduras. La nueva tabla de precios contempla incrementos en la mayoría de los derivados del petróleo , tanto en Tegucigalpa como en San Pedro Sula. El mayor aumento corresponderá al diésel, mientras que el GLP doméstico mantendrá su precio. En Tegucigalpa, el galón de gasolina súper aumentará 29 centavos y pasará a costar L139.12. En San Pedro Sula, el incremento será de 13 centavos, por lo que el nuevo precio será de L135.22. La gasolina regular también tendrá un incremento. En la capital subirá 81 centavos y su precio será de L128.23 por galón, mientras que en San Pedro Sula aumentará 66 centavos y se ubicará en L124.50. La SEN indicó que la gasolina regular mantiene un apoyo económico temporal de 81 centavos por galón en Tegucigalpa y de 66 centavos en San Pedro Sula. El diésel tendrá el mayor incremento de la nueva estructura. En Tegucigalpa subirá L3.89, alcanzando un precio de L138.14 por galón. En San Pedro Sula aumentará L3.73, para llegar a L134.35. En el caso del queroseno, el aumento será de L2.62 por galón en Tegucigalpa, donde tendrá un precio de L122.59. En San Pedro Sula subirá L2.46, hasta alcanzar los L118.66. El precio del gas licuado de petróleo (GLP) doméstico no tendrá modificaciones durante la nueva semana. El cilindro se mantendrá en L249.62 en Tegucigalpa y L228.47 en San Pedro Sula. El Gobierno continuará aplicando un apoyo económico temporal de L35.22 por cilindro en la capital y L35.58 en San Pedro Sula. Por otra parte, el GLP vehicular será el único producto que registrará una reducción de precio. En ambas ciudades, el galón disminuirá cinco centavos. De esta manera, tendrá un precio de L48.34 en Tegucigalpa y L44.81 en San Pedro Sula. Los nuevos precios estarán vigentes, desde el lunes 17 hasta la medianoche del domingo 23 de agosto, y corresponden a la estructura establecida por la Secretaría de Energía para los combustibles comercializados en el país.
data.translatedTitle: New fuel prices starting Monday, August 17 in Honduras
data.translatedDescription: The Ministry of Energy (SEN) announced the new fuel price structure that will come into effect as of Monday, August 17, 2026 in Honduras. The new price table includes increases in most oil derivatives, both in Tegucigalpa and San Pedro Sula. The largest increase will correspond to diesel, while domestic LPG will maintain its price. In Tegucigalpa, a gallon of super gasoline will increase by 29 cents and will cost L139.12. In San Pedro Sula, the increase will be 13 cents, so the new price will be L135.22. Regular gasoline will also have an increase. In the capital it will increase 81 cents and its price will be L128.23 per gallon, while in San Pedro Sula it will increase 66 cents and will be at L124.50. The SEN indicated that regular gasoline maintains a temporary economic support of 81 cents per gallon in Tegucigalpa and 66 cents in San Pedro Sula. Diesel will have the largest increase in the new structure. In Tegucigalpa it will rise L3.89, reaching a price of L138.14 per gallon. In San Pedro Sula it will increase by L3.73, to reach L134.35. In the case of kerosene, the increase will be L2.62 per gallon in Tegucigalpa, where it will have a price of L122.59. In San Pedro Sula it will rise L2.46, until reaching L118.66. The price of domestic liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) will not change during the new week. The cylinder will remain at L249.62 in Tegucigalpa and L228.47 in San Pedro Sula. The Government will continue to apply temporary economic support of L35.22 per cylinder in the capital and L35.58 in San Pedro Sula. On the other hand, vehicular LPG will be the only product that will register a price reduction. In both cities, the gallon will decrease by five cents. In this way, it will have a price of L48.34 in Tegucigalpa and L44.81 in San Pedro Sula. The new prices will be in effect from Monday, August 17th until midnight on Sunday, August 23rd, and correspond to the structure established by the Ministry of Energy for fuels marketed in the country.
