data.title: Buscan a Stephanie López, desaparecida en La Lima; la obligaron a subir a un carro
data.description: Cortés, Honduras.- ¿La has visto? Stephanie López , de 18 años, fue reportada como desaparecida la noche del miércoles -12 de agosto- en La Lima, Cortés . La joven salió de su lugar de trabajo, un supermercado ubicado en la colonia Jerusalén, y desde ese momento sus familiares desconocen su paradero. De acuerdo con el relato de la familia, Stephanie habría sido obligada a subir a un vehículo cuando salía del establecimiento donde trabajaba, por lo que sospechan que pudo tratarse de un posible secuestro, aunque esta versión no ha sido confirmada por las autoridades. Luis López, padre de Stephanie, pidió a las autoridades seguir con las labores de búsqueda para localizar a su hija con vida. Las circunstancias en las que la joven desapareció deberán ser establecidas mediante las investigaciones correspondientes, con la recopilación de testimonios y la verificación de si había cámaras de seguridad en las afueras del establecimiento. La familia de la joven permanece a la espera de información que permita conocer su paradero y esclarecer las circunstancias de su desaparición. Recientemente, Génesis María Ortiz Ramírez, de 11 años, quien había sido reportada como desaparecida desde el pasado 22 de julio en San Pedro Sula, Cortés, fue localizada con vida. La menor fue ubicada como resultado de las diligencias realizadas por agentes de la Dirección Policial de Investigaciones (DPI), en coordinación con la INTERPOL, informó la Policía Nacional. De acuerdo con información preliminar proporcionada por las autoridades, durante las diligencias la menor habría revelado que decidió abandonar su vivienda debido a presuntos abusos sexuales, señalamiento que deberá ser investigado por las autoridades competentes.
data.translatedTitle: They are looking for Stephanie López, missing in La Lima; They forced her into a car
data.translatedDescription: Cortés, Honduras.- Have you seen it? Stephanie López, 18, was reported missing on Wednesday night -August 12- in La Lima, Cortés. The young woman left her workplace, a supermarket located in the Jerusalem neighborhood, and since that moment her relatives have not known her whereabouts. According to the family's story, Stephanie was forced to get into a vehicle when she left the establishment where she worked, so they suspect that it could have been a possible kidnapping, although this version has not been confirmed by the authorities. Luis López, Stephanie's father, asked the authorities to continue the search efforts to locate his daughter alive. The circumstances under which the young woman disappeared must be established through the corresponding investigations, with the collection of testimonies and verification of whether there were security cameras outside the establishment. The young woman's family remains waiting for information that will allow us to know her whereabouts and clarify the circumstances of her disappearance. Recently, Génesis María Ortiz Ramírez, 11 years old, who had been reported missing since last July 22 in San Pedro Sula, Cortés, was located alive. The minor was located as a result of the procedures carried out by agents of the Police Investigation Directorate (DPI), in coordination with INTERPOL, the National Police reported. According to preliminary information provided by the authorities, during the proceedings the minor revealed that she decided to leave her home due to alleged sexual abuse, a statement that must be investigated by the competent authorities.

data.title: Niño de 3 años es hospitalizado tras ataque de un enjambre de abejas en Tegucigalpa
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Una familia vivió momentos de tensión luego de ser atacada por un enjambre de abejas africanizadas en la colonia Brisas de San José, situada en la carretera que conduce hacia Olancho, en Tegucigalpa. El hecho se registró durante la tarde del jueves -13 de agosto- y dejó a seis personas afectadas , entre ellas, tres menores de edad, quienes recibieron atención prehospitalaria por parte de elementos del Cuerpo de Bomberos. Alejandro Palma, sargento y portavoz de la institución, explicó que la emergencia fue reportada a través del Sistema Nacional de Emergencias 911, por lo que personal del Cuerpo de Bomberos se desplazó al lugar para atender a las víctimas del ataque. Entre los afectados se encuentra un niño de tres años, identificado como Ángel David Reyes , quien sufrió un choque anafiláctico, una reacción alérgica severa que puede presentarse tras una picadura. Ante la gravedad de la reacción, el menor fue llevado de emergencia al Hospital Materno Infantil, donde quedó bajo observación médica en el área de emergencias. Hasta el momento, no se han brindado más detalles sobre su estado de salud. Los otros dos menores y los tres adultos afectados sufrieron lesiones leves y también fueron valorados por los socorristas, debido al riesgo de que alguno presentara posteriormente una reacción alérgica. 1. Mantener la calma y cubrirse el rostro y la cabeza mientras se busca un lugar seguro. 2. No golpear ni intentar aplastar las abejas, ya que esto puede provocar que otras se acerquen. 3. Una vez a salvo, retirar los aguijones visibles con cuidado, sin manipular innecesariamente la zona. 4. Lavar el área afectada con agua y jabón y aplicar frío local para ayudar a disminuir la inflamación. 5. Vigilar la aparición de síntomas como dificultad para respirar, hinchazón de labios, lengua o garganta, mareos, debilidad o una reacción generalizada. 6. Si aparecen signos de una reacción alérgica grave, buscar atención médica de inmediato o llamar al Sistema Nacional de Emergencias 911.
data.translatedTitle: 3-year-old boy is hospitalized after a bee swarm attack in Tegucigalpa
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- A family experienced moments of tension after being attacked by a swarm of Africanized bees in the Brisas de San José colony, located on the road that leads to Olancho, in Tegucigalpa. The incident occurred during the afternoon of Thursday -August 13- and left six people affected, including three minors, who received pre-hospital care from elements of the Fire Department. Alejandro Palma, sergeant and spokesman for the institution, explained that the emergency was reported through the National Emergency System 911, so personnel from the Fire Department went to the scene to attend to the victims of the attack. Among those affected is a three-year-old boy, identified as Ángel David Reyes, who suffered anaphylactic shock, a severe allergic reaction that can occur after a sting. Given the severity of the reaction, the minor was rushed to the Maternal and Child Hospital, where he remained under medical observation in the emergency area. So far, no further details have been provided about his health status. The other two minors and the three affected adults suffered minor injuries and were also evaluated by lifeguards, due to the risk that some would later present an allergic reaction. 1. Stay calm and cover your face and head while looking for a safe place. 2. Do not hit or try to crush the bees, as this may cause others to approach. 3. Once safe, remove the visible stingers carefully, without unnecessarily manipulating the area. 4. Wash the affected area with soap and water and apply local cold to help reduce inflammation. 5. Monitor for symptoms such as difficulty breathing, swelling of the lips, tongue, or throat, dizziness, weakness, or a generalized reaction. 6. If signs of a serious allergic reaction appear, seek medical attention immediately or call the National Emergency System 911.

data.title: “Solo nos están tirando una hora el agua”: Tegucigalpa afronta crisis de agua y endurecen racionamiento
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Las reservas de agua de la capital de Honduras, Tegucigalpa, podrían caer a niveles críticos en las próximas semanas si no se registran lluvias significativas, lo que ha obligado a las autoridades a endurecer el racionamiento y suministrar el servicio cada nueve días por unas pocas horas. Tegucigalpa cuenta con cerca de dos millones de habitantes y vive desde hace años sumida en una crisis hídrica, pero esta se agravó en junio pasado, cuando se estableció un cronograma de racionamiento con el servicio cada siete días. Este jueves, el director del Sistema Municipal de Gestión de Riesgos, Julio Quiñónez, dijo a EFE que "el escenario de precipitaciones es todavía malo” y los embalses podrían entrar en niveles "críticos" de persistir este escenario. Ahora la represa La Concepción, que abastece cerca del 60 % de la capital, opera al 30 % de su capacidad, mientras que otro reservorio, el embalse Los Laureles, al 38 %, detalló el funcionario. Es por ello que desde el 1 de agosto el calendario de distribución pasó de siete a nueve días, con una disposición del servicio de entre dos y seis horas, dependiendo del lugar, en un intento de prolongar estas reservas. De no haberse hecho, los embalses habrían descendido al 20 % hacia el 20 de agosto, mientras que con el nuevo calendario ese umbral se prevé para el 20 de septiembre, según Quiñónez. A partir del 20 % de capacidad la presencia de sedimentos dificulta considerablemente el aprovechamiento del agua y, por debajo del 15 %, “deja de ser útil”, enfatizó. “Solo nos están tirando una hora el agua, cada ocho días”, relató a EFE Ada Maribel Núñez, de 54 años, residente en la colonia Ulloa, quien explicó que el suministro apenas alcanza para beber y realizar algunas tareas domésticas. La falta de suministro suficiente de agua en su hogar obliga a Núñez, miembro de una familia de siete integrantes, a trasladarse a unos lavaderos públicos para poder lavar la ropa. “Nosotros venimos a lavar aquí porque no tenemos agua en las casas”, afirmó, al pedir a las autoridades que mejoren el abastecimiento del líquido. Tegucigalpa distribuye unos 90.000 metros cúbicos de agua al día mediante una red pública que cubre cerca del 72 % de la población. El resto depende de la compra a camiones cisterna o de mecanismos de distribución estatal. La escasez se refleja en las filas para obtener agua de las cisternas y en las caminatas de habitantes que acuden a ríos y quebradas para lavar ropa. La crisis no responde únicamente a la falta de lluvias. Las autoridades reconocen que Tegucigalpa arrastra un déficit histórico de infraestructura para captar y almacenar agua, agravado por el crecimiento de la población. El alcalde de Tegucigalpa, Juan Diego Zelaya, dijo que la Alcaldía inició la rehabilitación de fuentes subterráneas para enfrentar la emergencia. Zelaya señaló que la sequía responde a un “fenómeno mundial” y destacó como solución estructural la construcción de la represa San José, un proyecto que no entrará en funcionamiento hasta 2028 y que, por tanto, no ofrece una respuesta inmediata a la actual emergencia. Mientras tanto, las autoridades municipales han pedido a la población extremar el ahorro del agua, a la espera de que las lluvias de las próximas semanas permitan aliviar la presión sobre las reservas y evitar que la capital hondureña entre en una fase crítica de desabastecimiento
data.translatedTitle: “They are only throwing water at us for one hour”: Tegucigalpa faces a water crisis and rationing is tightened
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The water reserves of the Honduran capital, Tegucigalpa, could fall to critical levels in the coming weeks if significant rains are not recorded, which has forced authorities to tighten rationing and provide service every nine days for a few hours. Tegucigalpa has nearly two million inhabitants and has been mired in a water crisis for years, but this worsened last June, when a rationing schedule was established with the service every seven days. This Thursday, the director of the Municipal Risk Management System, Julio Quiñónez, told EFE that "the rainfall scenario is still bad" and the reservoirs could enter "critical" levels if this scenario persists. Now the La Concepción dam, which supplies about 60% of the capital, operates at 30% of its capacity, while another reservoir, the Los Laureles reservoir, at 38%, the official explained. That is why since August 1, the distribution calendar went from seven to nine days, with a service provision of between two and six hours, depending on the location, in an attempt to prolong these reserves. If this had not been done, the reservoirs would have dropped to 20% by August 20, while with the new calendar this threshold is expected for September 20, according to Quiñónez. From 20% capacity onwards, the presence of sediments considerably hinders the use of water and, below 15%, “it is no longer useful,” he emphasized. “They are only throwing water at us for one hour, every eight days,” Ada Maribel Núñez, 54, a resident of the Ulloa neighborhood, told EFE, explaining that the supply is barely enough to drink and perform some domestic tasks. The lack of sufficient water supply in his home forces Núñez, a member of a family of seven, to go to public laundries to wash clothes. “We come to wash here because we don't have water in our homes,” he said, asking the authorities to improve the supply of liquid. Tegucigalpa distributes about 90,000 cubic meters of water per day through a public network that covers about 72% of the population. The rest depends on purchasing from tanker trucks or state distribution mechanisms. The shortage is reflected in the lines to obtain water from cisterns and in the walks of residents who go to rivers and streams to wash clothes. The crisis does not respond solely to the lack of rain. The authorities recognize that Tegucigalpa has a historical deficit in infrastructure to capture and store water, aggravated by population growth. The mayor of Tegucigalpa, Juan Diego Zelaya, said that the Mayor's Office began the rehabilitation of underground sources to face the emergency. Zelaya pointed out that the drought responds to a “global phenomenon” and highlighted the construction of the San José dam as a structural solution, a project that will not come into operation until 2028 and that, therefore, does not offer an immediate response to the current emergency. Meanwhile, municipal authorities have asked the population to save water as much as possible, waiting for the rains in the coming weeks to relieve pressure on reserves and prevent the Honduran capital from entering a critical phase of shortages.

data.title: Conadeh pide activar protocolo consular para asistir a Brayan Sánchez, hondureño deportado a África
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- El Comisionado Nacional de los Derechos Humanos ( Conadeh ) pidió al Gobierno de Honduras activar "de forma inmediata" un protocolo de asistencia consular para verificar el estado físico del hondureño Brayan Sánchez , deportado en julio de Estados Unidos a la República Centroafricana junto con cuatro cubanos y un ecuatoriano. Sánchez y los cubanos Omar Rodríguez, Arístides Fernández, Yasmany Moreno y Daniel Lázaro Fuente, además del ecuatoriano Mauricio Alvarado, fueron deportados sin previo aviso el 30 de julio a Bangui, capital de la República Centroafricana, donde aseguran temer por sus vidas y solo reciben atención de supuestos funcionarios de la ONU. En un comunicado del organismo, la coordinadora de la Defensoría de Movilidad Humana del Conadeh, Elsy Reyes, señaló que entre las acciones prioritarias del Estado hondureño debe estar constatar las condiciones físicas en las que se encuentra Sánchez y atender sus necesidades básicas urgentes. También consideró necesario que Honduras le emita un pasaporte, en caso de que no cuente con un documento que acredite su nacionalidad y le permita movilizarse internacionalmente, debido a que permanece en un país que, según dijo, "no reúne las condiciones básicas para tener una vida digna". Reyes recomendó además entrevistar al hondureño para conocer las alternativas que considera viables, siempre respetando su consentimiento. "El traslado a un tercer país sin el consentimiento de la persona y sin dominio del idioma constituye una violación al debido proceso", afirmó la defensora. Reyes destacó la necesidad de revisar, mediante un abogado, el debido proceso seguido en Estados Unidos para su deportación y señaló que cualquier eventual retorno a ese país debería producirse a través de una decisión judicial. No obstante, ante las actuales políticas migratorias estadounidenses, la activista estimó que lo más conveniente es que sea Sánchez quien determine si desea trasladarse a otro país, siempre dentro de los acuerdos que Estados Unidos mantiene con terceros Estados y con garantías para sus derechos humanos. El Conadeh sugirió revisar con qué otros países de la región existen convenios que permitan garantizar protección internacional, acceso al trabajo y condiciones de vida dignas en caso de que Sánchez no pueda regresar a Estados Unidos. La Cancillería hondureña reiteró este jueves que da seguimiento al caso de Sánchez y que apoyaría a gestionar su "retorno voluntario" a Honduras, pero el migrante sostiene que no puede regresar porque salió del país por amenazas de muerte de criminales. El caso refleja las crecientes deportaciones de migrantes por parte de la Administración de Donald Trump a terceros países en África, con acuerdos para que los acepten en Ruanda, Sudán del Sur, Esuatini, Uganda, Ghana, Camerún y la República Democrática del Congo, según el Instituto de Relaciones Internacionales y Estratégicas. La Administración elevó estos esfuerzos tras un fallo de la Corte Suprema que autorizó en junio de 2025 estas expulsiones. Desde entonces, ha "deportado a personas a condiciones inseguras sin debido proceso y con menos de 24 horas de aviso", aseveró el Proyecto Internacional de Asistencia a los Refugiados (IRAP).
data.translatedTitle: Conadeh asks to activate consular protocol to assist Brayan Sánchez, a Honduran deported to Africa
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The National Commissioner for Human Rights (Conadeh) asked the Government of Honduras to "immediately" activate a consular assistance protocol to verify the physical condition of Honduran Brayan Sánchez, deported in July from the United States to the Central African Republic along with four Cubans and an Ecuadorian. Sánchez and the Cubans Omar Rodríguez, Arístides Fernández, Yasmany Moreno and Daniel Lázaro Fuente, as well as the Ecuadorian Mauricio Alvarado, were deported without prior notice on July 30 to Bangui, capital of the Central African Republic, where they claim to fear for their lives and only receive attention from supposed UN officials. In a statement from the organization, the coordinator of the Conadeh Human Mobility Ombudsman's Office, Elsy Reyes, pointed out that among the priority actions of the Honduran State must be to verify the physical conditions in which Sánchez is found and attend to his urgent basic needs. He also considered it necessary for Honduras to issue him a passport, in case he does not have a document that proves his nationality and allows him to move internationally, because he remains in a country that, he said, "does not meet the basic conditions to have a dignified life." Reyes also recommended interviewing the Honduran to find out what alternatives he considers viable, always respecting his consent. "The transfer to a third country without the consent of the person and without mastery of the language constitutes a violation of due process," stated the defender. Reyes highlighted the need to review, through a lawyer, the due process followed in the United States for his deportation and pointed out that any eventual return to that country should occur through a judicial decision. However, given the current US immigration policies, the activist considered that the most convenient thing is for Sánchez to determine if he wishes to move to another country, always within the agreements that the United States maintains with third states and with guarantees for his human rights. Conadeh suggested reviewing which other countries in the region there are agreements that guarantee international protection, access to work and decent living conditions in the event that Sánchez cannot return to the United States. The Honduran Foreign Ministry reiterated this Thursday that it is following up on Sánchez's case and that it would support managing his "voluntary return" to Honduras, but the migrant maintains that he cannot return because he left the country due to death threats from criminals. The case reflects the increasing deportations of migrants by the Donald Trump Administration to third countries in Africa, with agreements to accept them in Rwanda, South Sudan, Eswatini, Uganda, Ghana, Cameroon and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the Institute of International and Strategic Relations. The Administration increased these efforts after a Supreme Court ruling that authorized these expulsions in June 2025. Since then, it has "deported people to unsafe conditions without due process and with less than 24 hours' notice," the International Refugee Assistance Project (IRAP) said.

data.title: Diario DIEZ, HCH y GOTV se unen para transmitir en exclusiva el partido Génesis vs Platense
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Diario Deportivo DIEZ, GOTV y HCH se unen por primera vez en una transmisión que marcará un nuevo hito en el fútbol de Honduras. Será este sábado al llevar en exclusiva el enfrentamiento entre Génesis FC y Platense desde el estadio Roberto Suazo Córdova de La Paz. Esta innovadora propuesta busca ofrecer una nueva dimensión para disfrutar del fútbol de la Liga Nacional de Honduras, brindándole a la afición una opción moderna y accesible para seguir los partidos del campeonato local. El encuentro marcará el inicio de una era que llega para quedarse en la televisión hondureña. Los aficionados podrán disfrutar del duelo del equipo canino totalmente gratis desde la comodidad de sus hogares a través de la señal de GOTV, canal disponible en las principales empresas de cable del país. A nivel nacional, GOTV se encuentra en TIGO, en HD por el 702 y en caja digital por el canal 14; en CLARO por canal 14 en digital y en análogo por el 33; en CABLE COLOR, 714 en HD, 14 en caja digital y canal 41 en análogo; igual en las diferentes cableras y repetidoras locales de Honduras. Asimismo, para la fanaticada en el extranjero, el partido se transmitirá en directo y en formato Full HD mediante el canal oficial de YouTube de Diario Deportivo DIEZ. Este compromiso representa el primer paso de un ambicioso proyecto en el que un equipo de profesionales cualificados llevará cada incidente del encuentro. La cobertura completa incluirá una previa detallada, el seguimiento minuto a minuto, repeticiones de jugadas claves y una emisión en alta definición. A su vez, los seguidores podrán mantenerse informados en tiempo real por medio de actualizaciones constantes en las plataformas digitales y sitios web de ambos medios. Grupo OPSA (Organización Publicitaria S.A.), HCH y el Club Génesis FC, buscan romper barreras en el entretenimiento deportivo a partir de la tercera jornada del Torneo Apertura 2026. Cabe destacar que GRUPO OPSA es la casa editora más grande de Honduras con sus medios de comunicación de diario EL HERALDO, diario LA PRENSA y Diario Deportivo DIEZ, el especialista en deportes de Honduras y la región; además de la televisora GOTV. Para garantizar la máxima calidad informativa del juego Génesis vs Platense de este sábado a las 3.00pm en La Paz por la jornada tres de la Liga Nacional de Honduras, un equipo periodístico de Diario Deportivo DIEZ, HCH y GOTV, se desplazaron con anticipación a la ciudad de La Paz, para brindar una cobertura integral previa al compromiso del club que se convierte en el pionero de esta familia televisiva. A esta iniciativa también se unen EL HERALDO y LA PRENSA, medios de comunicación que estarán catapultando el proyecto para lograr alcances sin precedentes en esta experiencia deportiva. La transmisión ofrecerá un enfoque fresco que combina la potencia del periodismo masivo y digital con la inmediatez de la televisión abierta y las plataformas de streaming en vivo. En el aspecto deportivo, el Génesis FC llega a este compromiso tras cosechar una victoria y una derrota en sus primeras dos presentaciones del certamen. Por su parte, el Platense busca enderezar el rumbo luego de caer en el debut ante Real España e igualar frente a Marathón. Ambos conjuntos prometen un duelo lleno de intensidad sobre el césped, el cual la afición podrá seguir bajo un concepto de transmisión totalmente renovado.

To guarantee the maximum informative quality of the Génesis vs Platense game this Saturday at 3:00 pm in La Paz for matchday three of the National League of Honduras, a journalistic team from Diario Deportivo DIEZ, HCH and GOTV, traveled in advance to the city of La Paz, to provide comprehensive coverage prior to the commitment of the club that becomes the pioneer of this television family. This initiative is also joined by EL HERALDO and LA PRENSA, media outlets that will be catapulting the project to achieve unprecedented achievements in this sporting experience. data.title: Así se disfrazó la mentira: radiografía de 393 bulos en siete meses de 2026
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La mentira cambió de rostro, formato y temática, pero mantuvo una fórmula reconocible durante los primeros siete meses de 2026: apropiarse de personajes, instituciones y acontecimientos reales para presentar como verdadero algo que nunca ocurrió. Entre el 1 de enero y el 31 de julio fueron desmentidos 393 bulos. La cifra retrata una corriente persistente de contenidos falsos o engañosos que atravesó asuntos políticos, conflictos internacionales, salud, educación, seguridad, fenómenos naturales y eventos deportivos. La desinformación no necesitó inventarlo todo. En ocasiones tomó una declaración auténtica y le arrancó el contexto. En otras puso palabras falsas en boca de una figura pública, fabricó una decisión gubernamental o presentó como real un proyecto legislativo inexistente. Para Edwin Ordóñez, docente de Periodismo Digital de la Universidad Nacional Autónoma de Honduras (UNAH), esta capacidad de fabricar y adaptar contenidos responde también al nivel de preparación de quienes los producen. “Las personas que están creando esta lluvia de bulos, deepfakes o noticias falsas son personas muy informadas y preparadas, expertas en crear un tsunami de desinformación que la mayor cantidad de población cree y divulga sin analizar si es verdadero, falso o está fuera de contexto”, afirmó. Gobierno y Congreso Nacional fueron las temáticas más utilizadas. En conjunto aparecieron en 152 casos, casi cuatro de cada diez bulos analizados. Esto no significa que ambas instituciones produjeran esos contenidos, sino que fueron convertidas en protagonistas involuntarias de las falsedades. La concentración de estos contenidos en la esfera política también tiene una explicación, según Ordóñez: “El hambre por poder, seguidores de entes políticos con odio y el mismo egocentrismo de algunos funcionarios y exfuncionarios profundiza que la crisis de la desinformación se concentre ahí”. La fórmula fue particularmente visible en los asuntos gubernamentales. De los 85 bulos vinculados con el Gobierno, 76 inventaron acciones del Ejecutivo. La mentira no se limitó a exagerar una medida: en la mayoría de esos casos creó la actuación desde cero. En el Congreso Nacional ocurrió algo similar. Una parte importante de los contenidos atribuyó a los diputados proyectos que no existían, tergiversó iniciativas o presentó supuestas decisiones legislativas como hechos consumados. Ordóñez resume esa dinámica de forma directa: “Ahora la guerra tiene dos lados: oficialismo y oposición lanzando mentiras a través de las fronteras sin control de las redes sociales”. La cita falsa fue el disfraz más utilizado. Un total de 99 contenidos atribuyó expresiones inexistentes a políticos, funcionarios, instituciones u otras figuras públicas. Esta modalidad ofrece una ventaja para quienes desinforman: una frase breve, colocada sobre una fotografía reconocible, puede parecer suficiente para provocar indignación, rechazo o respaldo. La apariencia sustituye a la evidencia y la reacción emocional se adelanta a la comprobación. El segundo recurso más frecuente fue sacar los hechos de contexto. En lugar de fabricar completamente una imagen, una declaración o un video, se reutilizó material real, pero separado de las circunstancias que permitían comprenderlo correctamente. Javier Franco, experto en desinformación, considera que esa transformación es una de las principales características del fenómeno en 2026: “La desinformación está evolucionando y haciéndose más sofisticada. Ya no necesita inventar completamente una noticia: puede utilizar una cita falsa, sacar un hecho verdadero de contexto, alterar una imagen o producir artificialmente una voz o un video”. Alina Donaire, investigadora de desinformación, coincide en que el cambio está marcado por una mayor sofisticación tecnológica: “No solo está creciendo en volumen, sino que se está sofisticando la tecnología, porque la inteligencia artificial se ha vuelto una herramienta central para generar cifras falsas, para descontextualizar y para crear deepfakes”. Entre las citas falsas y los contenidos descontextualizados se concentró casi la mitad de los casos. La radiografía muestra así que la desinformación no siempre construye una mentira completa: muchas veces le basta con mutilar la verdad. Para Franco, el cambio no está únicamente en el volumen de contenidos falsos, sino en la dificultad creciente para identificarlos: “el gran cambio de 2026 está allí: el problema ya no es solamente cuánto se desinforma, sino que cada vez resulta más difícil reconocer a simple vista aquello que es falso”. También se documentaron hechos falsos y 66 deepfakes. Estos últimos añadieron otro nivel de apariencia mediante audios, imágenes o videos manipulados. A ellos se sumaron suplantaciones, propuestas inexistentes, comunicados falsos y otras formas de fabricación digital. Donaire advierte: “hoy en día frecuentemente es lo más engañoso, sobre todo para las personas mayores, que no tienen ese conocimiento tecnológico y tampoco ese pensamiento crítico que se requiere para descubrir una desinformación". El resultado de la revisión fue contundente: 357 de los 393 contenidos fueron calificados como falsos. Los demás fueron considerados engañosos porque mezclaban elementos ciertos con omisiones, alteraciones o interpretaciones capaces de conducir al público hacia una conclusión equivocada. La mayor parte de los bulos fue detectada en Facebook. La plataforma reunió casi dos de cada tres casos analizados y se colocó ampliamente por encima de las demás redes sociales. TikTok ocupó el segundo lugar. Entre ambas plataformas concentraron nueve de cada diez contenidos desmentidos durante el periodo. X, WhatsApp, Instagram y Threads tuvieron una participación menor. Los datos no demuestran por sí solos que los 393 casos formaran parte de una operación coordinada. Sí permiten observar una desinformación constante, adaptable y capaz de encontrar espacio en las plataformas con mayor presencia dentro del análisis. Donaire señala que parte de esa dinámica también se relaciona con la circulación de cuentas que aparentan ser fuentes distintas, pero mantienen patrones similares de publicación. “Los perfiles falsos, que cambian de nombre, pero manejan la misma información, cambian de nombre constantemente, con millones, hasta 5 millones de seguidores estas cuentas. Hablamos también de una proliferación de desinformación", opinó. El volumen tampoco permaneció estable. Febrero registró el punto más bajo, pero la actividad aumentó en los meses posteriores hasta alcanzar sus mayores niveles en junio y julio. Este último cerró con 83 bulos, la cifra mensual más alta. La desinformación parecía seguir la conversación pública. Cuando cambiaba la coyuntura, también cambiaba su vestuario. Además del Gobierno y el Congreso, los bulos aprovecharon el posible regreso y el indulto de Juan Orlando Hernández, las elecciones, la política, las alzas de los combustibles y la disputa por la isla Conejo. También se colaron en la conversación sobre la guerra entre Estados Unidos, Irán e Israel, el Mundial de 2026, un supuesto doble terremoto en Venezuela, la captura de Nicolás Maduro y una masacre en Trujillo. Otros asuntos, desde el hantavirus y el sarampión hasta los paros de docentes y médicos, también sirvieron de materia prima. Para Donaire, esta amplitud demuestra que la desinformación dejó de estar limitada a la política y se adapta a cualquier acontecimiento capaz de captar la atención pública: “Ya no solo hablamos de temáticas políticas, como lo fue a inicios de año por el traspaso de presidencia. Ahora todo evento importante se presta para cualquier tipo de desinformación, y con eso hablamos no solo de política, economía, medio ambiente, sino que también hablamos de entretenimiento, hablamos de estafa". Franco recomienda que “el fact-checking es indispensable, pero muchas veces interviene cuando el contenido ya circuló y dejó una impresión en las personas. Por eso no basta con desmentir después; necesitamos también prevención y desarrollar mayor capacidad para valorar la información antes de compartirla”. En esa tarea, Ordóñez destaca el papel de los medios que verifican los contenidos que circulan en redes sociales: “El papel que desarrollan EH y LA PRENSA Verifica es fundamental. Hacerle frente a este tipo de pandemias no es nada fácil, pero ayuda a desmontar tanta noticia falsa y evitar tragedias”. La radiografía de los 393 bulos no muestra una mentira encerrada en una sola temática. Muestra un fenómeno que se mueve detrás de la actualidad, se apropia de sus protagonistas y adopta el formato más conveniente. A veces se presenta como declaración. Otras veces como video, comunicado, propuesta, encuesta o noticia urgente. Cambia de apariencia, pero conserva el mismo objetivo: lograr que una falsedad parezca lo suficientemente cierta como para ser compartida.
data.translatedTitle: This is how the lie was disguised: x-ray of 393 hoaxes in seven months of 2026
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The lie changed its face, format and theme, but maintained a recognizable formula during the first seven months of 2026: appropriating real characters, institutions and events to present as true something that never happened. Between January 1 and July 31, 393 hoaxes were debunked. The figure portrays a persistent stream of false or misleading content that crossed political issues, international conflicts, health, education, security, natural phenomena and sporting events. Disinformation did not need to invent everything. Sometimes he took an authentic statement and ripped out the context. In others he put false words in the mouth of a public figure, fabricated a government decision or presented a non-existent legislative project as real. For Edwin Ordóñez, professor of Digital Journalism at the National Autonomous University of Honduras (UNAH), this ability to manufacture and adapt content also responds to the level of preparation of those who produce it. “The people who are creating this rain of hoaxes, deepfakes or fake news are very informed and prepared people, experts in creating a tsunami of misinformation that the largest population believes and spreads without analyzing whether it is true, false or out of context,” he stated. Government and National Congress were the most used topics. Altogether they appeared in 152 cases, almost four out of every ten hoaxes analyzed. This does not mean that both institutions produced these contents, but rather that they were turned into involuntary protagonists of the falsehoods. The concentration of this content in the political sphere also has an explanation, according to Ordóñez: “The hunger for power, followers of political entities with hatred and the same egocentrism of some officials and former officials deepens the fact that the crisis of misinformation is concentrated there.” The formula was particularly visible in government affairs. Of the 85 hoaxes linked to the Government, 76 invented actions of the Executive. The lie was not limited to exaggerating a measure: in most of those cases it created the performance from scratch. Something similar happened in the National Congress. A significant part of the content attributed projects that did not exist to the deputies, distorted initiatives or presented supposed legislative decisions as fait accompli. Ordóñez summarizes this dynamic directly: “Now the war has two sides: the ruling party and the opposition throwing lies across borders without control of social networks.” The false quote was the most used disguise. A total of 99 contents attributed non-existent expressions to politicians, officials, institutions or other public figures. This modality offers an advantage for those who misinform: a short phrase, placed over a recognizable photograph, may seem enough to provoke indignation, rejection or support. Appearance replaces evidence and the emotional reaction precedes verification. The second most frequent resource was taking the facts out of context. Instead of completely fabricating an image, statement or video, real material was reused, but separated from the circumstances that allowed it to be properly understood. Javier Franco, an expert in disinformation, considers that this transformation is one of the main characteristics of the phenomenon in 2026: "Disinformation is evolving and becoming more sophisticated. You no longer need to completely invent a news story: you can use a false quote, take a true fact out of context, alter an image or artificially produce a voice or a video." Alina Donaire, disinformation researcher, agrees that the change is marked by greater technological sophistication: “Not only is it growing in volume, but the technology is becoming more sophisticated, because artificial intelligence has become a central tool to generate false figures, to decontextualize and to create deepfakes.” Almost half of the cases were concentrated between false quotes and decontextualized content. The x-ray thus shows that misinformation does not always create a complete lie: it is often enough to mutilate the truth. For Franco, the change is not only in the volume of false content, but in the growing difficulty of identifying them: “the great change of 2026 is there: the problem is no longer just how much misinformation is being provided, but that it is increasingly difficult to recognize at a glance what is false.” False facts and 66 deepfakes were also documented. The latter added another level of appearance through manipulated audio, images or videos. Added to these were impersonations, non-existent proposals, false communications and other forms of digital fabrication. Donaire warns: "today it is often the most misleading, especially for older people, who do not have that technological knowledge or that critical thinking that is required to discover misinformation." The result of the review was overwhelming: 357 of the 393 contents were classified as false. The others were considered misleading because they mixed certain elements with omissions, alterations or interpretations capable of leading the public towards the wrong conclusion. Most of the hoaxes were detected on Facebook. The platform brought together almost two out of every three cases analyzed and was widely placed above other social networks. TikTok took second place. Between both platforms, nine out of ten contents denied during the period were concentrated. X, WhatsApp, Instagram and Threads had a smaller participation. The data alone do not demonstrate that the 393 cases were part of a coordinated operation. They do allow us to observe constant, adaptable disinformation capable of finding space on the platforms with the greatest presence within the analysis. Donaire points out that part of this dynamic is also related to the circulation of accounts that appear to be different sources, but maintain similar publication patterns. "The fake profiles, which change their names, but handle the same information, constantly change their names, with millions, up to 5 million followers of these accounts. We are also talking about a proliferation of misinformation," he said. The volume also did not remain stable. February recorded the lowest point, but activity increased in subsequent months until reaching its highest levels in June and July. The latter closed with 83 hoaxes, the highest monthly figure. Misinformation seemed to follow the public conversation. When the situation changed, his wardrobe also changed. In addition to the Government and Congress, the hoaxes took advantage of the possible return and pardon of Juan Orlando Hernández, the elections, politics, fuel increases and the dispute over Conejo Island. They also slipped into the conversation about the war between the United States, Iran and Israel, the 2026 World Cup, an alleged double earthquake in Venezuela, the capture of Nicolás Maduro and a massacre in Trujillo. Other issues, from hantavirus and measles to teacher and doctor strikes, also served as raw material. For Donaire, this breadth shows that misinformation is no longer limited to politics and adapts to any event capable of capturing public attention: "We no longer only talk about political issues, as it was at the beginning of the year due to the transfer of the presidency. Now every important event lends itself to any type of misinformation, and with that we talk not only about politics, the economy, the environment, but we also talk about entertainment, we talk about scam." Franco recommends that "fact-checking is essential, but it often intervenes when the content has already circulated and left an impression on people. That is why it is not enough to deny it afterwards; we also need prevention and developing a greater capacity to evaluate the information before sharing it." In this task, Ordóñez highlights the role of the media that verify the content circulating on social networks: "The role played by EH and LA PRENSA Verifica is fundamental. Facing this type of pandemic is not easy, but it helps to dismantle so much false news and avoid tragedies." The x-ray of the 393 hoaxes does not show a lie enclosed in a single theme. It shows a phenomenon that moves behind current events, appropriates its protagonists and adopts the most convenient format. Sometimes it is presented as a statement. Other times as a video, statement, proposal, survey or urgent news. It changes its appearance, but maintains the same objective: to make a falsehood seem true enough to be shared.

data.title: INIMESTEST AEGAMÖÖDA ⟩ Martin Pakk. Vahva poiss Vabriku puiesteelt
data.description: Martin Paki isa oli Martin Pakk. Võib-olla sai poeg isa nime sellepärast, et ta ei ole oma isa kunagi näinud. Et isa nii vere kui nime läbi noorimas pojas edasi elaks. Kui ema Helene Martinit 1941. aasta 21. juulil Türil Mäe tänaval Järvelite maja keldris sünnitas, oli isal elada jäänud veel neljakümne päeva jagu. 1941. aasta 1. septembril kell 18.10 õhtul lasid NKVD mõrtsukad ta Kirovi vanglas maha.
data.translatedTitle: ABOUT PEOPLE THROUGH TIME ⟩ Martin Pakk. A great boy from Factory Boulevard
data.translatedDescription: Martin Pak's father was Martin Pakk. Perhaps the son got his father's name because he has never seen his father. That the father would live on in the youngest son through both blood and name. When the mother gave birth to Helene Martin on July 21, 1941 in the basement of the Järvelite house on Türil Mäe Street, the father still had forty days left to live. On September 1, 1941, at 18:10 in the evening, NKVD assassins shot him in Kirov prison.

data.title: RAIVO VARE ⟩ Eesti kindlustas kiirelt ja läbimõeldult oma iseseisvust Venemaa nõrkusehetkel
data.description: Aastatel 1990–1992 Edgar Savisaare valitsuse riigiministrina töötanud Raivo Vare sõnul tuli iseseisva riigi loomise juures kõike käigupealt õppida, kuna teadmisi polnud õieti kellelgi. Pärast 20. augustit 1991 hakkas valitsus ellu viima «kolm korda kolm» plaani: kolme nädalaga kindlustada iseseisvus de facto; kolme kuuga tuli tagada iseseisvuse pöördumatus; kolm aastat – seda võiks nimetada «tagasi Euroopasse» programmiks.
data.translatedTitle: RAIVO VARE ⟩ Estonia quickly and thoughtfully secured its independence at a moment of Russian weakness
data.translatedDescription: According to Raivo Vare, who worked as a minister of state in Edgar Savisaare's government from 1990 to 1992, everything had to be learned on the fly when creating an independent state, because no one really had the knowledge. After August 20, 1991, the government began to implement the "three times three" plan: to secure de facto independence in three weeks; the irreversibility of independence had to be ensured in three months; three years - it could be called a "back to Europe" program.

data.translatedTitle: FACE OF THE WEEK ⟩ Kristen Michal, the captain of the leaking and sinking boat, will not be able to get off the boat until March
data.translatedDescription: The final week began with the inevitable for Prime Minister Kristen Michal (RE) - her government became a minority government. It was bound to happen at some point anyway.

data.title: NÄDALA NÄGU ⟩ Naisdetektiivide kujuline auk televaatajate hinges
data.description: Eestis on suhteliselt mõeldamatu, et sa pole televaatajana kordagi näinud ühtki «Kättemaksukontori» jagu või et sa ei tea vähemalt seda, kes on Frida, Marion või Häidi. Või ka Freya või Luna. Või isegi Lumi-Lee, Barbara ning Madis.
data.translatedTitle: FACE OF THE WEEK ⟩ A hole in the soul of TV viewers in the shape of female detectives
data.translatedDescription: In Estonia, it is relatively unthinkable that you, as a TV viewer, have never seen a single episode of "Kättemaksukontor" or that you at least do not know who Frida, Marion or Häidi are. Or Freya or Luna too. Or even Snow-Lee, Barbara and Madis.

data.title: NÄDALA NÄGU ⟩ Võimalikult neutraalne kandidaat presidendiks
data.description: Molekulaargeneetiku asemel võib presidendiks saada neurobiokeemik, endise Eesti Maaülikooli ja Tartu Ülikooli rektori asemel endine Tallinna Ülikooli ja praegune Taltechi rektor – selline valik teeb muidugi Eestile kui haridus- ja teadussõbralikule riigile au.
data.translatedTitle: FACE OF THE WEEK ⟩ A possibly neutral candidate for president
data.translatedDescription: Instead of a molecular geneticist, a neurobiochemist can become the president, instead of the former rector of the Estonian University of Life Sciences and the University of Tartu, the former rector of Tallinn University and the current rector of Taltech - of course, such a choice does honor to Estonia as an education- and science-friendly country.

data.title: FOTOD JA VIDEO ⟩ Rootsi vangid Tartusse: paremad tingimused, suurem palk ja kaks telerit kambris
data.description: Peagi saabuvad Tartu vanglasse esimesed Rootsi kinnipeetavad, kellele kehtivad erinevad reeglid ja tingimused. Alates tasuta televiisorist ja ööpäevaringsest elektrikasutusest kuni selleni, et kartserikaristust neile ei määrata – luksus, mida Eesti vangidel pole.
data.translatedTitle: PHOTOS AND VIDEO ⟩ Swedish prisoners to Tartu: better conditions, higher salary and two TVs in the cell
data.translatedDescription: Soon, the first Swedish inmates will arrive in Tartu prison, to whom different rules and conditions apply. From free television and 24/7 electricity to the fact that they are not sentenced to solitary confinement - a luxury that Estonian prisoners do not have.

data.title: Plagiaadiskandaali sattunud Cambridge'i eksprofessor leiti surnuna
data.description: Mustanahaline Briti akadeemik Jason Arday, kes astus eelmisel nädalal tagasi Cambridge'i ülikoolist seoses laialdast vastukaja leidnud plagiaadiskandaaliga, millega on kaasnenud rassismisüüdistused, leiti reedel surnuna, teatas Ühendkuningriigi meedia.
data.translatedTitle: An ex-Cambridge professor caught up in a plagiarism scandal has been found dead
data.translatedDescription: Jason Arday, a black British academic who resigned from Cambridge University last week amid a high-profile plagiarism scandal that has drawn accusations of racism, was found dead on Friday, UK media reported.

data.title: London kritiseeris Netanyahut «ÜK islamivabariigi» kommentaari pärast

data.translatedDescription: Britain sharply criticized Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Friday, who mockingly called the country an Islamic republic in an interview.

data.title: KARM VIDEO ⟩ Kolm hunti tungisid Põhja-Pärnumaal taluõuele: kaks kiskjat ründasid veriselt kolmandat
data.description: Ööpimeduses taluõuele ilmunud kolme hundi kohtumine võttis hetkega verise pöörde, kui kaks kiskjat kolmandale kallale sööstsid. Hommikul avanes pererahvale kõhe vaatepilt: verepritsmed katsid isegi laste jalgratast ja mänguasju.
data.translatedTitle: HARD VIDEO ⟩ Three wolves invaded a farm yard in North Pärnu County: two predators bloody attacked the third
data.translatedDescription: The meeting of the three wolves that appeared in the farm yard in the dark of the night took a bloody turn in an instant, when two predators pounced on the third. In the morning, the family saw a sickening sight: blood spatter even covered the children's bicycle and toys.

data.title: GALERII ⟩ Täielik küte! Triibupasta vallutas lava ja lõi juubelihõngulisele hiphopifestivalile hoo sisse
data.description: Reedel Elvas alanud Eesti hiphop festival (EHHF) tähistab tänavu oma 20. sünnipäeva. Kahe päeva jooksul astub mändide all üles enam kui kakskümmend artisti ning reedeõhtuse programmi käivitas hoogsalt kell 20 pealava vallutanud triibupasta.
data.translatedTitle: GALLERY ⟩ Full Heat! Stripe paste conquered the stage and kicked off the jubilee hip-hop festival
data.translatedDescription: The Estonian Hip Hop Festival (EHHF), which started in Elva on Friday, is celebrating its 20th birthday this year. Over the course of two days, more than twenty artists will perform under the pine trees, and the Friday evening program was kicked off by the striped pasta, which took over the main stage at 8 p.m.

data.title: AVAMEREPURJETAMISE EM ⟩ Shadow võitis Euroopa meistrivõistluste rannikusõidu, Sugar jätkab üldarvestuses teisena. Homme selguvad võitjad!
data.description: Klaipėdas peetavatel ORC Euroopa meistrivõistlustel võitis reedel C-klassi 40 meremiili pikkuse rannikusõidu Harles Liivi juhitud Shadow. Eesti edu täiendas Henri Roihu juhitud Sugar teise kohaga, mis hoiab meeskonna enne viimast võistluspäeva C-klassi üldarvestuses kindlalt teisel kohal.
data.translatedTitle: EURO OFFSHORE SAILING ⟩ Shadow wins European Coastal Race, Sugar continues second overall. The winners will be announced tomorrow!
data.translatedDescription: At the ORC European Championship held in Klaipėda, Shadow, led by Harles Liiv, won the C-class 40-nautical-mile coastal race on Friday. Sugar, led by Henri Roihu, completed Estonia's success with second place, which keeps the team firmly in second place in the C class overall before the last day of competition.

data.title: VIDEO ⟩ Lennureisijatel läksid ühtäkki kõhud lahti: põhjus peitus pardal pakutud joogis
data.description: Hiina lennufirma China Southern Airlinesi lennul tekkis pärast ploomimahla serveerimist väidetavalt ootamatu tualetikriis. Reisijate sõnul mõjus kahtlase sisuga pruunikas jook seedimisele sedavõrd hoogsalt, et lennuki tualettide ette tekkisid pikad järjekorrad. Lennufirma on aga juhtunut kommenteerides öelnud, et osa internetis levivatest väidetest ja fotodest on liialdatud. Mahlast nad siiski loobuda ei kavatse: «Me pakume seda ikka edasi…»
data.translatedTitle: VIDEO ⟩ Passengers' stomachs suddenly opened up: the reason lay in the drink offered on board
data.translatedDescription: A China Southern Airlines flight reportedly had an unexpected toilet crisis after being served plum juice. According to the passengers, the brownish drink with suspicious content had such a powerful effect on digestion that long queues formed in front of the plane's toilets. Commenting on the incident, however, the airline has said that some of the statements and photos circulating on the Internet are exaggerated. However, they are not going to give up the juice: "We will still offer it..."

data.title: VIDEO ⟩ Kregor Zirk: olen pettunud, ma ei käi tiitlivõistlustel poolfinaalikohtade pärast

data.translatedTitle: VIDEO ⟩ Kregor Zirk: I'm disappointed, I'm not going to the title race for semi-final places

data.title: Romanian swimmer David Popovici claims third European 200m freestyle title after 100m triumph
data.description: Romanian swimming star David Popovici has won the 200m freestyle race at the European Aquatics Championships in Paris, his third consecutive European title in the event. The win on August 14, following the August 12 gold in the 100m freestyle race , makes him the only athlete to have won both races at three consecutive editions of the European championships. The 21-year-old Romanian swimmer finished the race with a time of 1:44.15, 0.40 seconds ahead of runner-up Tomas Navikonis of Lithuania, and 0.72 seconds ahead of Britain's James Guy. In the 200m freestyle event, Popovici also won the Olympic gold in Paris in 2024, as well as two world titles, in Budapest in 2022 and in Singapore in 2025. His personal best in the 200m freestyle came at the 2022 European Championships, when he clocked 1:42.97, the third-fastest time in history. (Photo: Cateyeperspective/ Dreamstime ) simona@romania-insider.com

data.title: Romanian executive to submit fifth payment request under Recovery and Resilience Facility
data.description: The Romanian government is set to submit the fifth payment request under the EU-backed Recovery and Resilience Facility, or PNRR, according to an announcement from European Investments and Projects minister Dragoș Pîslaru. Payment no. 5 is worth EUR 2.84 billion, and is the penultimate request that Romania will submit within the PNRR. Once approved, the fifth payment will bring Romania’s absorption rate of PNRR-related grants to 78%, from 66% currently. “One final request remains, request no. 6, worth EUR 2.58 billion in grants and EUR 1.76 billion in loans. From a total of EUR 13.57 billion allocated at the time the PNRR was signed, we will reach EUR 10.56 billion after request no. 5,” Pîslaru said during a press conference . Initially, the European Commission planned for a single final payment request, reuniting the now separated requests no. 5 and 6, the minister noted. The final payment request will be submitted at the end of September, and with it “we could reach 97.2% of the PNRR,” he said, referring to the grants component. “47% was the percentage of the PNRR when I came to the ministry, after four years since the program was launched. The annual average was about 10.4% of the PNRR. In one year and two months, under the Bolojan government, we added 31% of the PNRR,” the minister also said. Romania’s National Recovery and Resilience Plan is financed through EUR 21.41 billion under the EU mechanism, including EUR 13.57 billion in grants and EUR 7.84 billion in loans.  The fourth payment request, worth EUR 2.62 billion, was approved by the European Commission in May of this year. radu@romania-insider.com (Photo source: gov.ro)

data.title: Drone crashes in Romania’s Tulcea County
data.description: A drone crashed on Friday, August 14, in the area of Luncaviţa, a locality in eastern Romania’s Tulcea County, about five kilometers from the border with Ukraine, the Defense Ministry (MApN) announced . The drone crashed in a wooded area and caused no casualties, according to preliminary information provided by MApN. The drone was not detected by MApN’s radar surveillance systems as it was flying at a very low altitude, the ministry said. The crash resulted in an explosion followed by a fire, which has been extinguished, the Emergency Situations Inspectorate of Tulcea announced. A MApN team, using an IAR 330 PUMA SOCAT helicopter, will investigate the area. A day earlier, drone remains were discovered in the sea, close to Romania’s Costinești beach , on the Black Sea shore. Five drones were tracked nearing Romanian territory on the night of Wednesday, August 12, to Thursday, August 13, around 1 AM. One drone briefly entered Romanian airspace in Tulcea County but then exited and headed to Ukraine. Another drone was detected in Romanian airspace around 9 AM. Earlier this week, two Gerbera-type drones were destroyed by divers of the Romanian Army in the exclusive economic zone, approximately 165 kilometers from Constanța, in the Neptun Deep exploitation area. At the end of the August 14 government meeting, prime minister Ilie Bolojan said the country’s military was doing “everything in their power to combat the drones.” “We have a reality that we cannot deny, namely that the war resulting from Russia’s aggression against Ukraine is having an impact, including along our borders, and we can expect drone debris, drones reaching the river areas along Romania’s border, in the vicinity of ports, to stray into Romania,” the PM said . “It is regrettable that we are facing such situations, but given what has happened in recent months, we are beginning to see that this is becoming something of a constant; it is not just in Romania, we have seen what has happened in other areas as well. It is becoming clear that equipping our Armed Forces as quickly as possible with counter-drone systems is a necessity,” he added. (Photo: Trentinness/ Dreamstime ) simona@romania-insider.com

data.title: Romanian telco Digi reports 10% higher revenues in Q2 2026
data.description: Romanian telecommunications company Digi (BVB: DIGI) reported consolidated revenues of EUR 608 million in the second quarter of 2026, representing an 11% YoY increase. Adjusted EBITDA (ex. operating leases) for Q2 2026 increased by 23% compared to the result from Q2 2025, reaching EUR 169 million. Consequently, in the first semester of 2026, the group recorded consolidated revenues of EUR 1.2 billion, a 10% increase versus 6M 2025, and adjusted EBITDA of EUR 398 million, up 17% YoY. “Spain continues to be our primary growth engine, maintaining strong commercial momentum and progressing in line with our long-term plans, while Romania continued to perform well,” said Serghei Bulgac, CEO of Digi Communications. Last month, Digi successfully completed an initial public offering for its Spanish subsidiary. The Spanish IPO was multiple times oversubscribed, showing investor appetite for the company’s shares. In Q2 2026, Digi reached 33.9 million revenue-generating user agreements (RGUs) across Romania, Spain, Portugal and Italy, a 14% increase compared to Q2 2025. The mobile segment stands out for generating the most RGUs within the group’s array of services, accounting for 51% of the overall clients across the four markets. In Q2 2026, the mobile segment saw its RGUs climb to 17.3 million, a 19% YoY increase, covering mobile telephony clients across Romania, Spain, Portugal and Italy. In Romania, the mobile service segment remained the largest, reaching 8.4 million RGUs as of the end of Q2 2026, a positive evolution of 20% compared to Q2 2025. Broadband services registered an increase of 4% in Q2 2026, compared to Q2 2025, up to 5.2 million RGUs, while the segment of Pay-TV services (cable and satellite) increased by 2% YoY, up to 6.1 million RGUs. Together with fixed-line telephony, the total number of RGUs in the Romanian market amounted to 20.5 million customers as of Q2 2026, a 9% increase versus Q2 2025. Spanish operations continued the strong performance in Q2 2026, with the number of users of fixed services, internet, and mobile telephony increasing by 23% compared to Q2 2025, to 11.9 million RGUs. Mobile users increased by 19% to 7.8 million RGUs, while broadband users increased by 28% to 2.9 million. In Portugal, the number of RGUs amounted to 960k, up 22% YoY, of which 545k were mobile, and 186k were broadband users. In Italy, mobile users increased by 4,5% YoY, reaching 535k RGUs as of the end of Q2 2026. In the United Kingdom, Digi launched its fiber broadband services and continued expanding its network footprint during the second quarter of 2026, while onboarding its first customers. radu@romania-insider.com (Photo source: Lenuta Idi|Dreamstime.com )

data.title: Romania’s Presidential Administration to host summit on animal welfare
data.description: The Presidential Administration will host the second edition of Animal Summit Romania on September 29 - 30, Diana Pungă, a state adviser for relations with civil society at the institution, announced on Friday, August 14. The event, organized by the non-profit Sache Vet Association and Bucharest’s Animal Protection Administration ASPA, will take place at Cotroceni Palace. Over two days, it will gather public administration representatives, veterinarians, legal and education specialists, non-governmental organizations and other experts to discuss animal protection and welfare and solutions to challenges in the field. “Romania continues to face major challenges in the field of animal protection. Beyond the issue of abandonment and the lack of education about responsible pet ownership, civil society frequently raises concerns about the non-transparent operation of some private shelters, suspected abusive euthanasia practices and difficulties in uniformly enforcing existing legislation. In many communities, volunteers, NGOs and active citizens end up compensating for the lack of coherent institutional mechanisms by becoming directly involved in animal rescue, shelter monitoring and the promotion of responsible sterilization and adoption,” an announcement from the organizers reads . All of these aspects point to an urgent need for clear standards and consistently implemented public policies protecting both the communities and the animals, the organizers said. (Photo: Wirestock | Dreamstime.com ) simona@romania-insider.com

data.title: Central Romania: EBRD extends EUR 120 mln loan for PV plant, battery system near Brașov
data.description: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) announced on Friday, August 14, that it has extended a financing package of up to EUR 120 million for the development, construction, and operation of Econergy’s Părău 2 project in Romania. The project includes a 342 MW solar photovoltaic plant and a 150 MW/300 MWh battery storage system in Brașov, according to a statement by the lender. The financing consists of an EBRD A loan of up to EUR 57 million and an EBRD B loan of up to EUR 63 million, which includes a EUR 3.6 million debt service guarantee provided by commercial banks Privredna banka Zagreb and NLB. According to the EBRD, the Părău 2 project will increase renewable energy production, help improve grid flexibility, and strengthen Romania’s energy security. data.title: Romanian consumer goods distributor AQUILA reports slightly higher revenues amid challenging context
data.description: AQUILA, one of the largest players in the fast-moving consumer goods distribution sector from Romania and the region, reported revenues of RON 1.6 billion in the first half of 2026, amid an economic environment marked by declining consumption, according to a report submitted to the local stock exchange . The figure represents a 6.4% increase compared to the same period last year. Revenue from the distribution segment increased by 6% in the first half of 2026 compared to the same period in 2025, driven by the organic growth of this business line. The main contributor to this performance was the traditional retail channel, which grew by 22%, followed by the HoReCa channel with 7% growth, and the gas station channel with 1%, evolutions that offset the 19% decline recorded in the organized retail channel. Revenue from the logistics segment increased by 6%, driven by higher operating volumes and the expansion of logistics activities across multiple temperature categories, particularly in the frozen products segment. Revenue from the transport segment increased by 13%. The company's own brands continued to strengthen their contribution to the group’s performance, with revenues of RON 78.5 million in the first half of 2026, up 23% compared to the same period in 2025. The results for the first half of the year were affected by a more challenging operating environment, marked by weaker consumer spending in Romania, an approximately 30% increase in fuel costs, and unfavorable foreign exchange movements, as well as by the temporary impact of the group’s market share expansion strategy and continued investments in the development of our operating platform. In this context, EBITDA amounted to approximately RON 61 million, down 33% compared to the same period in 2025, while the net result was negative, at approximately RON 21 million. During the first six months of the year, the group invested EUR 3 million in the development of its logistics infrastructure, process digitalization, operations automation, and equipment modernization, in line with its growth strategy and commitment to improving operational efficiency. “Our distribution segment continued to deliver growth, supported by the expansion of the traditional retail and HoReCa channels, the consolidated contribution of our own brands, and the commercial synergies generated through the integration of the acquired companies. At the same time, we chose to prioritize strengthening commercial relationships and increasing market share, which play an essential role in supporting long-term growth and value creation,” said Cătălin Vasile, CEO of AQUILA. The company head noted that the strategy had a temporary impact on commercial margins and profitability but created “a foundation for capitalizing on the investments made and supporting sustainable performance in the period ahead.” radu@romania-insider.com (Photo source: company photo)

data.title: Raiffeisen Bank Romania issues a new series of bonds denominated in RON
data.description: Raiffeisen Bank, one of the largest banks in Romania, issued on August 13, 2026, a senior preferred eligible bond issue maturing in 2033, with a total value of RON 750 million. The tranche represents the bank’s 0th series of eligible bonds, the financial institution informs through a statement sent to Economica.net . The bond issue was addressed to institutional investors and was placed at a fixed coupon of 7.538% for the first five years, respectively 0.85% above the yield of the benchmark Romanian government bonds denominated in lei. The bonds received a Baa1 rating from the rating agency Moody’s, two notches above Romania’s sovereign rating (Baa3). After obtaining approval from the National Bank of Romania, the bonds are set to be included in the bank’s own funds and eligible liabilities base and listed on the Luxembourg and Bucharest stock exchanges. In Romania, Raiffeisen Bank serves approximately 2.4 million individual and corporate customers. The bank has been active in Romania for more than 25 years. Earlier this year, Raiffeisen bought Garanti BBVA's ​Romanian business for EUR 591 million, its ‌first significant acquisition in recent years. The deal marked a turning point for Raiffeisen, which has long been under pressure to withdraw ​from Russia due to its invasion of ​Ukraine and the imposition of Western sanctions on ⁠Moscow. radu@romania-insider.com (Photo source: press release)

data.title: Central Romania: Winners Holding Investments, Finas Group commission 100 MWh energy storage battery after EUR 25 million investment
data.description: Cluj-based companies Winners Holding Investments and Finas Group have commissioned the second energy storage battery in their joint portfolio, with a capacity of 100 MWh, following an investment of more than EUR 25 million. The project, located in Glodeni, in Mureș County, comes several months after the companies signed a Memorandum of Understanding with China’s equipment producer Sieyuan Electric Co., Ltd., the companies said. In April, the first unit in the companies’ portfolio, a 10 MWh battery located in Aghireșu, in Cluj County, was completed. A third battery, with a capacity of 200 MWh, is scheduled for completion by November in Jibou, in Sălaj County. The project is valued at approximately EUR 45 million. “Each battery brought online represents a concrete step toward a more stable and flexible energy infrastructure for Romania. We thank all our partners and collaborators for their professionalism and support during this challenging period for the energy market, as well as the management team, led by Tudor Strilciuc, for the rigorous implementation of these projects,” Claudiu Șugar, the representative of Winners Holding Investments and Finas Group, said. (Photo: the companies) simona@romania-insider.com

data.title: Colliers: Rents up by 12% YoY for offices in central Bucharest amid limited supply
data.description: The limited supply of modern, well-located space continues to put upward pressure on rents in central Bucharest, pushing them upwards by nearly 12% at the end of June 2026 compared to a year ago, according to the mid-year market update report from real estate consultant Colliers. More than 100,000 square meters of office space were leased in Bucharest in the first half of 2026, slightly below the level recorded in the same period of 2025. Average rents in central Bucharest and other central areas rose from EUR 16 to EUR 18 per square meter, the same source said. Across the market as a whole, average rents rose by around 3%, while new projects currently under development are quoting rents 10-15% above the levels typically seen in their respective submarkets. According to Colliers, this shows that although demand remains below historical averages, the limited availability of competitive office space is gradually strengthening the position of landlords with buildings in highly sought-after locations. ”The office market is currently sending two signals that may appear contradictory at first: leasing volumes remain modest, yet rents are rising for good-quality space. The explanation lies in limited supply, amid suboptimal leasing demand. Companies continue to look for modern, efficient and well-located buildings, while the number of genuine options meeting these criteria is shrinking in central areas,” said Victor Coșconel, Partner | Head of Leasing | Office & Industrial Agencies at Colliers. New demand, meaning transactions that directly contribute to higher occupancy levels, recorded a slight increase in the first half of the year. Overall, however, leasing activity remains below the average of recent years and is closer to 2020-2021 levels than to those seen before the pandemic. Nevertheless, Collier’s consultants are seeing signs that could support a gradual market recovery in the period ahead. Several companies are assessing new leases, including players entering the local market for the first time, particularly service centers from Western Europe seeking premises of several thousand square meters. The IT&C sector has also recovered slightly from recent lows, although activity remains well below pre-pandemic levels. Another factor that could support demand is employees returning to the office more frequently. In many companies outside the IT sector, mandatory office attendance increased from one or two days per week to three days in 2025, while a growing number of employers are now discussing four days per week, a model that could become increasingly widespread. The profile of companies driving demand is also changing. While the IT sector accounted for over half of Bucharest leasing activity in 2019, its share fell to around 20% in 2025, though it increased to 31% as of the first half of 2026. Meanwhile, financial services, the energy sector, construction companies, professional services and consumer goods companies each accounted for 8-9% of leasing demand in the first half of 2026. Limited supply, even when considering the lackluster leading demand, remains the main factor supporting rental growth, Colliers consultants emphasized. No new office projects were delivered in Bucharest in the first half of 2026, following a 2025 with no deliveries. However, the market is beginning to move again: just over 50,000 square meters of new office space are expected to be delivered over the full year, while projects currently under construction could add nearly 300,000 square meters of modern office space over the next few years. Even so, the volume remains low compared with peak years, when more than 200,000 square meters could be delivered in a single year. The overall vacancy rate edged up to 12.25% in mid-2026, from 11.75% at the end of 2025, although the increase came mainly from peripheral areas. In competitive, well-located buildings, available space remains limited, with vacancies generally in single digits or even close to zero. In the Central Business District, vacancy remains at approximately 4%, while rents reach up to EUR 24 per square meter per month, compared with a high of EUR 22 at the end of last year. The differences are also evident between submarkets. In Floreasca - Barbu Văcărescu, the vacancy rate stands at around 5%, while in Pipera it reaches 40%. This shows that Bucharest’s overall vacancies are heavily influenced by a small number of areas and buildings, while significantly less space is available in competitive projects. This widening gap between modern, well-located buildings and the rest of the market is not unique to Bucharest. The regional ExCEEding Borders Office 2026 report, recently published by Colliers for the six main office markets in Central and Eastern Europe - Bucharest, Warsaw, Prague, Budapest, Bratislava and Sofia – shows that new office supply is at historical lows across the region, while prime rents are under upward pressure in all six capitals. radu@romania-insider.com (Photo source: Andreasg/ Dreamstime )
